async def test_publication_idempotency_is_workspace_scoped_and_social_unchanged(sf):
    a, b = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)
    shared = "shared-publish-key"
    ids = []
    async with api_client(sf) as c:
        for w in (a, b):
            h = await headers(sf, w)
            base = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}"
            brand = await c.put(f"{base}/brand", headers=h, json={"name": "Brand"})
            content = await c.post(f"{base}/contents", headers=h, json={"brand_id": brand.json()["id"], "title": "Hi", "body": "Body", "platform": "telegram"})
            assert content.json()["kind"] == "social"
            cid = content.json()["id"]
            assert (await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/submit-review", headers=h)).status_code == 200
            # legacy client still sends a spoofed actor; it must be ignored
            assert (await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/approve", headers=h, json={"actor": "Mallory", "note": "ok"})).status_code == 200
            assert (await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/publish", headers=h,
                                 json={"idempotency_key": shared, "credential_id": str(w.wp_id)})).status_code == 422
            r = await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/publish", headers=h, json={"idempotency_key": shared})
            assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
            ids.append(r.json()["id"])
            assert r.json()["content_version_id"] is None
    assert ids[0] != ids[1]
    async with sf() as s:
        approvals = (await s.execute(select(Approval).where(Approval.workspace_id.in_([a.workspace_id, b.workspace_id])))).scalars().all()
        outbox = (await s.execute(select(OutboxEvent).where(OutboxEvent.workspace_id.in_([a.workspace_id, b.workspace_id])))).scalars().all()
    assert {x.approver_user_id for x in approvals} == {a.user_id, b.user_id} and all(x.actor != "Mallory" for x in approvals)
    assert len(outbox) == 2 and {e.event_type for e in outbox} == {"content.publish.requested"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ credentials & schema


def test_credential_schema_supports_store_providers_without_leaking_secrets():
    ok = ProviderCredentialCreate(provider="woocommerce", credential_name="shop", secret="ck_1234:cs_5678",
                                  metadata={"base_url": "https://shop.example.com"})
    assert ok.metadata["base_url"].startswith("https://")
    for bad in (
        dict(provider="wordpress", metadata={}),
        dict(provider="wordpress", metadata={"base_url": "http://blog.example.com"}),
        dict(provider="telegram", metadata={"api_token": "abc"}),
        dict(provider="telegram", metadata={"Bad Key": "x"}),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            ProviderCredentialCreate(credential_name="name", secret="12345678", **bad)
    assert not {"secret", "encrypted_secret"} & set(ProviderCredentialRead.model_fields)


async def test_credential_metadata_persisted_and_secret_encrypted(sf):
    w = await make_world(sf)
    async with sf() as s:
        row = await s.get(ProviderCredential, w.woo_id)
    assert row.metadata_json == {"base_url": "https://shop.example.com"}
    assert "ck_x" not in row.encrypted_secret


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ migration / schema integrity


async def test_migrated_schema_has_expected_constraints_and_no_global_idempotency(sf):
    async with sf() as s:
        constraints = {r[0] for r in (await s.execute(text("SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint"))).all()}
        triggers = {r[0] for r in (await s.execute(text("SELECT tgname FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal"))).all()}
        version = (await s.execute(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version"))).scalar_one()
    assert version == "0006_product_content"
    assert {
        "uq_publication_workspace_idempotency", "uq_outbox_workspace_idempotency", "uq_product_job_workspace_idempotency",
        "uq_content_version_no", "uq_product_snapshot_source", "fk_content_current_version_same_content",
        "fk_approval_version_same_content", "fk_publication_version_same_content", "fk_publication_workspace_credential",
        "fk_product_job_workspace_snapshot", "ck_product_job_revision_count", "ck_product_job_max_revisions",
    } <= constraints
    assert not {"uq_publication_idempotency", "uq_outbox_idempotency"} & constraints
    assert {"content_versions_guard", "product_snapshots_immutable"} <= triggers


async def test_orm_metadata_matches_migrated_schema_for_phase1_objects(sf):
    from alembic.autogenerate import compare_metadata
    from alembic.migration import MigrationContext

    from app import communication_domain, engagement_domain, hardening_domain, product_domain  # noqa: F401
    from app.domain import Base

    def diff(sync_conn):
        ctx = MigrationContext.configure(sync_conn, opts={"compare_type": False})
        return compare_metadata(ctx, Base.metadata)

    async with sf() as s:
        conn = await s.connection()
        diffs = await conn.run_sync(diff)
    phase1 = ("content_versions", "product_snapshots", "product_content_jobs")
    relevant = [d for d in diffs if any(t in repr(d) for t in phase1)]
    assert not relevant, relevant

# دامنه Product Content (Phase 1 — پیاده‌سازی‌شده)

فقط **مدل داده و قواعد دامنه**. WooCommerce، AI، WordPress، n8n و UI در فازهای بعد هستند. Migration: `0006_product_content`.

## منبع حقیقت
| مفهوم | قانون |
|---|---|
| `ContentVersion` | تغییرناپذیر (trigger در PostgreSQL + guard در ORM). `validation_report` و `quality_report` فقط یک‌بار (NULL → مقدار) نوشته می‌شوند. شماره نسخه: `unique(content_id, version_no)` + قفل ردیف محتوا. |
| `ContentItem(kind='product')` | `title/body/current_version_id` فقط آینه‌ی نسخه‌ی جاری‌اند و فقط `product_services.add_content_version` آن‌ها را می‌نویسد؛ نوشتن مستقیم خطا می‌دهد. `kind='social'` رفتار قبلی را حفظ می‌کند. |
| `ProductSnapshot` | تغییرناپذیر. هویت = `(workspace, credential, external_product_id, source_hash)`. داده‌ی یکسان ⇒ همان snapshot؛ هر تغییر ⇒ snapshot جدید (قدیمی‌ها دست‌نخورده می‌مانند). |
| `ProductContentJob` | فقط وضعیت pipeline؛ محتوا ندارد. یک job برای هر ContentItem. |

## چرخه‌ی Job (`transition_job` تنها مسیر تغییر وضعیت)
`queued → generating → validating → quality_review → ready_for_review → completed`؛ مسیرهای `revising` (سقف `max_revisions` ≤ 5 در کد و DB)، `needs_attention`، `failed`، `cancelled`. ورود به `ready_for_review` نیازمند نسخه‌ی جاری با `validation_report.passed=true` است و محتوا را وارد `in_review` می‌کند؛ `completed` فقط بعد از `published`.

## Approval / Publication
- Approval همیشه `approver_user_id` را از کاربر احراز‌شده می‌گیرد؛ `actor` ارسالی کلاینت نادیده گرفته می‌شود. برای محتوای product، `content_version_id` الزامی و باید نسخه‌ی **جاری** (و validated، با job در `ready_for_review`) باشد. ورود به review از مسیر `submit-review` برای product ممنوع است.
- Publication روی نسخه‌ی تأییدشده‌ی جاری و یک credential فعال `wordpress` همان workspace pin می‌شود. کلید idempotency در `publications` و `outbox_events` اکنون `(workspace_id, key)` است. Foreign keyهای ترکیبی از ارجاع بین-tenant و بین-محتوا جلوگیری می‌کنند.
- `ProviderCredential`: providerهای `woocommerce`/`wordpress` و `metadata_json` غیرمحرمانه (`base_url` با https). Secret فقط رمزشده و هرگز در پاسخ نیست.

## محدودیت‌های شناخته‌شده (فازهای بعد)
- رویداد `product_content.publish.requested` ساخته می‌شود اما اجرای آن (WordPress) و routing صریح worker در Phase 4/5 است؛ تا آن زمان worker رویداد ناشناخته را به webhook قبلی می‌فرستد.
- Self-approval کنترل نمی‌شود. حذف cascade (workspace) روی `content_versions` مجاز است؛ فقط UPDATE مسدود است.
- اصلاحات Phase 0 که هنوز انجام نشده‌اند: DLQ→state، قفل heartbeat، helper یکتای secret، حذف `/automation/outbox*`، `key_id` برای Fernet.

## تست
`apps/api/tests/test_product_domain.py` (نیازمند `DATABASE_URL`؛ بدون آن skip می‌شود).

# Phase 2 — WooCommerce Product Pipeline

Implement only Phase 2.

Do not rescan the repository or re-audit previous phases.

## 1. Target

Implement the production-grade WooCommerce pipeline:

WooCommerce
→ secure product retrieval
→ normalization
→ deterministic validation
→ ProductSnapshot
→ ProductContentJob

Before implementation, inspect only:
- existing WooCommerce-related code/config, if any
- Phase 1 ProductSnapshot/ProductContentJob/credential models and services
- immediate API/service/test dependencies required for this phase

Verify only what Phase 2 directly depends on from Phase 1.
Do not repeat Phase 0/1 findings.

## 2. WooCommerce Integration

Implement a focused WooCommerce client/service with:

- secure credential usage
- HTTPS-only endpoints
- strict connection/read timeouts
- bounded response size
- safe pagination/limits
- controlled retries only for transient failures
- no retry for authentication/authorization or validation failures
- clear typed/domain errors
- no secrets in logs or exceptions

Treat all WooCommerce data as untrusted external input.

## 3. SSRF Protection

The WooCommerce endpoint must be protected against SSRF.

At minimum:

- allow HTTPS only
- reject localhost/loopback
- reject private/internal IP ranges
- reject link-local addresses
- reject metadata-service addresses
- safely handle DNS resolution
- do not follow unsafe redirects
- prevent hostname tricks that bypass validation

Do not weaken these checks for development convenience.

## 4. Product Normalization

Implement deterministic normalization of the WooCommerce product into the Phase 1 ProductSnapshot format.

Normalize only the fields actually required by the Product Content pipeline.

Requirements:

- deterministic output
- explicit field validation
- bounded text/array sizes
- safe handling of missing/null fields
- preserve external product ID
- preserve source/credential/workspace ownership
- do not trust HTML/scripts/instructions contained in product data

External product text must remain data, not executable instructions for later AI processing.

## 5. Snapshot & Idempotency

Create ProductSnapshot only after successful retrieval + normalization + validation.

Use deterministic source hashing/deduplication according to the Phase 1 schema.

Repeated retrieval of unchanged product data must not create unnecessary duplicate snapshots.

Changed source data must produce a new immutable snapshot.

Enforce workspace boundaries server-side.

The credential, snapshot, and workspace relationships must be validated server-side.

## 6. ProductContentJob

Create the ProductContentJob from the valid snapshot.

Requirements:

- workspace-safe
- deterministic idempotency key
- no duplicate job for the same logical request
- correct initial state
- correct snapshot relationship
- safe concurrent requests

Do not implement AI generation or later pipeline states beyond what is required to create the initial job.

## 7. API / Service Boundary

Expose only the minimal application endpoint/service required to trigger the WooCommerce product pipeline.

Do not create unnecessary endpoints.

Do not expose credentials or raw secrets.

Do not allow the client to choose workspace ownership, credential ownership, or authorization-sensitive fields.

Use the authenticated user's workspace context.

## 8. Failure Handling

Handle distinctly:

- invalid credentials
- unreachable WooCommerce
- timeout
- unsafe endpoint
- invalid product response
- product not found
- normalization/validation failure
- duplicate/idempotent request
- unexpected upstream failure

Failures must not create partially valid domain state.

Use transactions where required.

## 9. Tests

Add focused tests only for Phase 2:

- WooCommerce authentication
- timeout/error handling
- SSRF protection
- unsafe redirects
- malformed/untrusted product data
- normalization determinism
- source hash determinism
- snapshot deduplication
- changed-product snapshot creation
- ProductContentJob creation
- workspace isolation
- job idempotency
- concurrent duplicate requests
- credential/ownership validation

Preserve existing tests.

Do not implement future AI/WordPress/n8n/E2E test suites.

## Restrictions

Do NOT implement:

- AI generation
- AI quality evaluation
- revision engine
- human-review UI
- WordPress integration
- n8n/Telegram changes
- new frontend features
- Phase 7 hardening unrelated to this pipeline
- Phase 8 E2E implementation
- unrelated refactors

Do not start Phase 3.

## Completion

Before finishing:

1. Run focused Phase 2 tests.
2. Run relevant existing regression tests.
3. Verify no secrets are exposed.
4. Verify SSRF protections.
5. Verify snapshot/job idempotency and workspace isolation.
6. Verify no future-phase functionality was implemented.

Keep the final response minimal.

Do not repeat previous phase findings.
Do not summarize unchanged architecture.
Do not provide a long report.

After successful completion, respond exactly:

Phase 2 complete.

If genuinely blocked:

Phase 2 complete — blocker: <short concrete description>.

STOP.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- snapshots


async def get_or_create_snapshot(
    session: AsyncSession,
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID,
    credential_id: uuid.UUID,
    external_product_id: str,
    data: dict,
    *,
    fetched_at: datetime | None = None,
    commit: bool = True,
) -> tuple[ProductSnapshot, bool]:
    """Return ``(snapshot, created)``.

    Semantics: identity = (workspace, credential, external_product_id, source_hash).
    Identical normalized data -> the existing snapshot (deduplicated, ``created=False``).
    ANY change in the data -> a new immutable snapshot row; older rows are never touched.
    """
    external_product_id = (external_product_id or "").strip()
    if not external_product_id or len(external_product_id) > 64:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="external_product_id must be 1..64 characters")
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Snapshot data must be a non-empty object")
    canonical = canonical_json(data)
    if len(canonical.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Snapshot data is too large")
    source_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    credential = (
        await session.execute(
            select(ProviderCredential).where(
                ProviderCredential.id == credential_id,
                ProviderCredential.workspace_id == workspace_id,
            )
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if credential is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Credential not found in workspace")
    if credential.provider != "woocommerce" or credential.status != ProviderCredentialStatus.active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="An active woocommerce credential is required")

    values = {
        "id": uuid.uuid4(),
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "credential_id": credential_id,
        "external_product_id": external_product_id,
        "source_hash": source_hash,
        "schema_version": SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "data": data,
        "fetched_at": fetched_at or datetime.now(UTC),
    }
    inserted = (
        await session.execute(
            pg_insert(ProductSnapshot)
            .values(**values)
            .on_conflict_do_nothing(constraint="uq_product_snapshot_source")
            .returning(ProductSnapshot.id)
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    snapshot = (
        await session.execute(
            select(ProductSnapshot).where(
                ProductSnapshot.workspace_id == workspace_id,
                ProductSnapshot.credential_id == credential_id,
                ProductSnapshot.external_product_id == external_product_id,
                ProductSnapshot.source_hash == source_hash,
            )
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- jobs


async def create_product_content_job(
    session: AsyncSession,
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID,
    snapshot_id: uuid.UUID,
    idempotency_key: str,
    *,
    created_by_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    max_revisions: int = DEFAULT_MAX_REVISIONS,
    commit: bool = True,
) -> tuple[ProductContentJob, bool]:
    """Create the job + its product ContentItem atomically. Returns ``(job, created)``."""
    if not 8 <= len(idempotency_key or "") <= 180:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="idempotency_key must be 8..180 characters")
    if not 0 <= max_revisions <= HARD_MAX_REVISIONS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"max_revisions must be 0..{HARD_MAX_REVISIONS}")

    async def _existing() -> ProductContentJob | None:
        return (
            await session.execute(
                select(ProductContentJob).where(
                    ProductContentJob.workspace_id == workspace_id,
                    ProductContentJob.idempotency_key == idempotency_key,
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

    existing = await _existing()
    if existing is not None:
        if existing.snapshot_id != snapshot_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Idempotency key already used for another snapshot")
        return existing, False

    snapshot = (
        await session.execute(
            select(ProductSnapshot).where(
                ProductSnapshot.id == snapshot_id, ProductSnapshot.workspace_id == workspace_id
            )
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if snapshot is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Snapshot not found in workspace")
    brand = (
        await session.execute(select(BrandProfile).where(BrandProfile.workspace_id == workspace_id))
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if brand is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="A brand profile is required before product content")

    name = snapshot.data.get("name") if isinstance(snapshot.data, dict) else None
    title = (name.strip() if isinstance(name, str) and name.strip() else f"Product {snapshot.external_product_id}")[:180]
    try:
        content = ContentItem(
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            brand_id=brand.id,
            title=title,
            body="",
            platform="wordpress",
            status=ContentStatus.draft,
            kind=CONTENT_KIND_PRODUCT,
        )
        session.add(content)
        await session.flush()
        job = ProductContentJob(
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            snapshot_id=snapshot_id,
            content_id=content.id,
            status=ProductJobStatus.queued,
            max_revisions=max_revisions,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            created_by_user_id=created_by_user_id,
        )
        session.add(job)
        await (session.commit() if commit else session.flush())
    except IntegrityError:
        await session.rollback()
        existing = await _existing()
        if existing is None:
            raise

        await session.refresh(job)

"""SSRF protection for outbound calls to merchant-controlled endpoints.

Defence in depth:
1. ``validate_endpoint_url``  - strict syntactic checks (https only, port 443, no userinfo, no
   query/fragment, real DNS name or public IP literal, no numeric/obfuscated hosts).
2. ``resolve_public_addresses`` - EVERY resolved address must be globally routable and not in the
   explicit metadata/internal blocklist. One bad record rejects the host.
3. ``SafeNetworkBackend`` - re-resolves and re-validates at CONNECT time and connects to the
   validated IP (TLS/SNI/Host keep the original name). This closes DNS-rebinding/TOCTOU gaps.
4. Redirects are never followed (enforced by the client).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import ipaddress
import re
import socket
import ssl
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import httpcore
import httpx


class UnsafeEndpointError(Exception):
    """The endpoint is not an acceptable public HTTPS target. Message never contains secrets."""

    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(reason)
        self.reason = reason


Resolver = Callable[[str, int], Awaitable[list[str]]]

_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES = (".localhost", ".local", ".internal", ".localdomain", ".lan", ".home.arpa", ".intranet", ".corp")
_FORBIDDEN_URL_CHARS = re.compile(r"[\s\\\x00-\x1f\x7f]")
_LABEL = re.compile(r"^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-)$")

# Ranges that Python considers "global" but that must never be reachable from the server.
_EXTRA_BLOCKED = tuple(
    ipaddress.ip_network(n)
    for n in (
        "168.63.129.16/32",  # Azure WireServer / metadata helper
        "64:ff9b::/96",  # NAT64 (embeds arbitrary IPv4)
        "64:ff9b:1::/48",
        "2002::/16",  # 6to4 (embeds arbitrary IPv4)
        "2001::/32",  # Teredo
        "100.64.0.0/10",
        "192.0.0.0/24",
        "198.18.0.0/15",
    )
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Endpoint:
    base_url: str  # normalized, no trailing slash
    host: str  # lower-case, IDNA (ASCII) form
    port: int = 443


def is_public_address(value: str) -> bool:
    try:
        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(value.split("%", 1)[0])
    except ValueError:
        return False
    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address) and ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
        ip = ip.ipv4_mapped
    if not ip.is_global or ip.is_multicast or ip.is_unspecified or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local:
        return False
    return not any(ip in net for net in _EXTRA_BLOCKED if net.version == ip.version)


def validate_endpoint_url(url: str) -> Endpoint:
    if not isinstance(url, str) or not url or len(url) > 500:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint URL is missing or too long")
    if _FORBIDDEN_URL_CHARS.search(url):
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint URL contains forbidden characters")
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        port = parts.port
        hostname = parts.hostname
    except ValueError:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint URL is malformed") from None
    if parts.scheme != "https":
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("only https endpoints are allowed")
    if parts.username is not None or parts.password is not None or "@" in parts.netloc:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("credentials in the URL are not allowed")
    if parts.query or parts.fragment or "?" in url or "#" in url:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("query strings and fragments are not allowed")
    if port not in (None, 443):
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("only port 443 is allowed")
    if not hostname:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint host is missing")

    host = hostname.lower().rstrip(".")
    is_ip_literal = True
    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(host)
    except ValueError:
        is_ip_literal = False
    if is_ip_literal:
        if not is_public_address(host):
            raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint address is not publicly routable")
    else:
        try:
            host = host.encode("idna").decode("ascii")
        except UnicodeError:
            raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint host is not a valid DNS name") from None
        labels = host.split(".")
        if len(labels) < 2 or len(host) > 253 or not all(_LABEL.match(label) for label in labels):
            raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint host is not a valid public DNS name")
        if host == "localhost" or host.endswith(_BLOCKED_SUFFIXES):
            raise UnsafeEndpointError("internal host names are not allowed")
        # Blocks decimal/hex/octal IPv4 spellings such as 2130706433 or 0x7f.1.
        if not any(c.isalpha() for c in labels[-1]):
            raise UnsafeEndpointError("numeric host names are not allowed")

    path = parts.path.rstrip("/")
    if "//" in path or ".." in path.split("/") or "%" in path:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint path is not allowed")
    shown_host = f"[{host}]" if ":" in host else host
    return Endpoint(base_url=f"https://{shown_host}{path}", host=host)


async def default_resolver(host: str, port: int) -> list[str]:
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    infos = await loop.getaddrinfo(host, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    return sorted({info[4][0] for info in infos})


async def resolve_public_addresses(host: str, port: int = 443, resolver: Resolver | None = None) -> list[str]:
    try:
        addresses = await (resolver or default_resolver)(host, port)
    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint host could not be resolved") from None
    if not addresses:
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint host could not be resolved")
    if not all(is_public_address(a) for a in addresses):
        raise UnsafeEndpointError("endpoint resolves to a non-public address")
    return list(addresses)


class SafeNetworkBackend(httpcore.AnyIOBackend):
    """Validates the destination at connect time and connects to the validated IP."""

    def __init__(self, resolver: Resolver | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._resolver = resolver

    async def connect_tcp(self, host, port, timeout=None, local_address=None, socket_options=None):  # type: ignore[override]
        addresses = await resolve_public_addresses(host, port, self._resolver)
        last: Exception | None = None
        for address in addresses:
            try:
                return await super().connect_tcp(
                    address, port, timeout=timeout, local_address=local_address, socket_options=socket_options
                )
            except (httpcore.ConnectError, httpcore.ConnectTimeout) as exc:
                last = exc
        assert last is not None
        raise last


class PinnedHTTPTransport(httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport):
    """httpx transport whose sockets are only opened through ``SafeNetworkBackend``."""

    def __init__(self, resolver: Resolver | None = None, *, max_connections: int = 4) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._pool = httpcore.AsyncConnectionPool(
            ssl_context=ssl.create_default_context(),
            max_connections=max_connections,
            max_keepalive_connections=0,
            keepalive_expiry=0,
            http1=True,
            http2=False,
            network_backend=SafeNetworkBackend(resolver),
        )

"""WooCommerce REST client (read-only) and deterministic product normalization.

Everything coming back from WooCommerce is UNTRUSTED data: it is size-bounded, type-checked, stripped
of markup and control characters, and only ever stored as plain-text data fields.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import html
import json
import logging
import re
import unicodedata
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from html.parser import HTMLParser

import httpx

from app.product_domain import SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION
from app.ssrf import (
    Endpoint,
    PinnedHTTPTransport,
    Resolver,
    UnsafeEndpointError,
    resolve_public_addresses,
    validate_endpoint_url,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("risheh.engage.woocommerce")

MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 512 * 1024
MAX_RETRIES = 2  # 3 attempts in total
RETRY_STATUSES = frozenset({429, 502, 503, 504})
MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS = 5.0
TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0
HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(connect=5.0, read=10.0, write=5.0, pool=5.0)

PRODUCT_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- errors


class WooError(Exception):
    """Base typed error. ``message`` is safe to show to users (never contains secrets/URLs)."""

    code = "woocommerce_error"

    def __init__(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        super().__init__(message or self.code)
        self.message = message or self.code


class WooUnsafeEndpoint(WooError):
    code = "unsafe_endpoint"


class WooAuthError(WooError):
    code = "invalid_credentials"


class WooUnreachable(WooError):
    code = "unreachable"


class WooTimeout(WooError):
    code = "timeout"


class WooNotFound(WooError):
    code = "product_not_found"


class WooInvalidResponse(WooError):
    code = "invalid_response"


class WooUpstreamError(WooError):
    code = "upstream_error"


class ProductValidationError(WooError):
    code = "product_validation_failed"


class _Transient(Exception):
    def __init__(self, kind: str, retry_after: float = 0.0) -> None:
        self.kind, self.retry_after = kind, retry_after


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- credentials


def parse_consumer_credentials(secret: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Stored secret format: ``<consumer_key>:<consumer_secret>``."""
    key, sep, value = (secret or "").partition(":")
    key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
    if not sep or not key or not value or len(key) > 200 or len(value) > 200:
        raise WooAuthError("stored WooCommerce credential is malformed")
    return key, value


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- client


class WooCommerceClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        consumer_key: str,
        consumer_secret: str,
        *,
        resolver: Resolver | None = None,
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
        sleep=asyncio.sleep,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            self._endpoint: Endpoint = validate_endpoint_url(base_url)
        except UnsafeEndpointError as exc:
            raise WooUnsafeEndpoint(exc.reason) from None
        self._auth = httpx.BasicAuth(consumer_key, consumer_secret)
        self._resolver = resolver
        # Production: every socket goes through the connect-time SSRF check. Tests may inject a transport.
        self._transport = transport or PinnedHTTPTransport(resolver)
        self._sleep = sleep

    def __repr__(self) -> str:  # never expose credentials
        return f"WooCommerceClient(host={self._endpoint.host!r})"

    async def get_product(self, product_id: str) -> dict:
        if not PRODUCT_ID_RE.match(product_id or ""):
            raise ProductValidationError("product id must be a positive integer")
        try:
            await resolve_public_addresses(self._endpoint.host, self._endpoint.port, self._resolver)
        except UnsafeEndpointError as exc:
            raise WooUnsafeEndpoint(exc.reason) from None

        url = f"{self._endpoint.base_url}/wp-json/wc/v3/products/{product_id}"
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS):
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    transport=self._transport, auth=self._auth, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, follow_redirects=False
                ) as client:
                    return await self._get_with_retries(client, url)
        except TimeoutError:
            raise WooTimeout("WooCommerce did not respond in time") from None

    async def _get_with_retries(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, url: str) -> dict:
        last: _Transient | None = None
        for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            try:
                return await self._get_once(client, url)
            except _Transient as exc:
                last = exc
                logger.warning("woocommerce transient failure kind=%s attempt=%d", exc.kind, attempt + 1)
                if attempt < MAX_RETRIES:
                    await self._sleep(min(MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS, max(exc.retry_after, 0.5 * 2**attempt)))
        assert last is not None
        if last.kind == "timeout":
            raise WooTimeout("WooCommerce did not respond in time")
        if last.kind == "network":
            raise WooUnreachable("WooCommerce could not be reached")
        raise WooUpstreamError("WooCommerce is temporarily unavailable")

    async def _get_once(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient, url: str) -> dict:
        try:
            async with client.stream("GET", url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"}) as response:
                status = response.status_code
                if 300 <= status < 400:
                    raise WooUnsafeEndpoint("redirects are not followed")
                if status in RETRY_STATUSES:
                    raise _Transient("upstream", _retry_after(response.headers.get("retry-after")))
                body = await _read_bounded(response)
        except UnsafeEndpointError as exc:
            raise WooUnsafeEndpoint(exc.reason) from None
        except httpx.TimeoutException:
            raise _Transient("timeout") from None
        except (httpx.TransportError, OSError):
            raise _Transient("network") from None

        if status in (401, 403):
            raise WooAuthError("WooCommerce rejected the credentials")
        if status == 404:
            if _error_code(body).startswith("woocommerce_rest_"):
                raise WooNotFound("product not found")
            raise WooInvalidResponse("endpoint is not a WooCommerce REST API")
        if status >= 400:
            raise WooUpstreamError(f"WooCommerce returned HTTP {status}")
        if status != 200:
            raise WooInvalidResponse("unexpected HTTP status")
        return _parse_json_object(body)


async def _read_bounded(response: httpx.Response) -> bytes:
    declared = response.headers.get("content-length")
    if declared and declared.isdigit() and int(declared) > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES:
        raise WooInvalidResponse("response is too large")
    chunks, size = [], 0
    async for chunk in response.aiter_raw():
        size += len(chunk)
        if size > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES:
            raise WooInvalidResponse("response is too large")
        chunks.append(chunk)
    body = b"".join(chunks)
    if response.headers.get("content-encoding", "identity") not in ("", "identity"):
        raise WooInvalidResponse("unsupported content encoding")
    return body


def _retry_after(value: str | None) -> float:
    try:
        return min(MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS, max(0.0, float(value))) if value else 0.0
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0


def _error_code(body: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
        code = data.get("code") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        return code if isinstance(code, str) else ""
    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
        return ""


def _parse_json_object(body: bytes) -> dict:
    try:
        data = json.loads(body)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise WooInvalidResponse("response is not valid JSON") from None
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise WooInvalidResponse("response is not a JSON object")
    return data


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- normalization

MAX_NAME = 200
MAX_SKU = 100
MAX_DESCRIPTION = 10_000
MAX_SHORT_DESCRIPTION = 2_000
MAX_TERMS = 20
MAX_TERM_LEN = 100
MAX_ATTRIBUTES = 30
MAX_OPTIONS = 50
MAX_OPTION_LEN = 100
STOCK_STATUSES = frozenset({"instock", "outofstock", "onbackorder"})
PRODUCT_STATUSES = frozenset({"publish", "draft", "pending", "private", "future"})
_PRICE_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{1,10}(\.\d{1,4})?$")
_TYPE_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,29}$")
_BLOCK_TAGS = frozenset({"p", "div", "br", "li", "ul", "ol", "tr", "table", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "blockquote", "section", "article"})
_SKIP_TAGS = frozenset({"script", "style", "noscript", "template", "iframe", "object", "embed", "svg", "head", "title"})


class _TextExtractor(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts: list[str] = []
        self._skip = 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):  # noqa: ARG002
        if tag in _SKIP_TAGS:
            self._skip += 1
        elif tag in _BLOCK_TAGS:
            self.parts.append("\n")

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):  # noqa: ARG002
        if tag in _BLOCK_TAGS:
            self.parts.append("\n")

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in _SKIP_TAGS:
            self._skip = max(0, self._skip - 1)
        elif tag in _BLOCK_TAGS:
            self.parts.append("\n")

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self._skip:
            self.parts.append(data)


def clean_text(value: object, max_len: int, field: str, *, multiline: bool = False) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    """Return ``(plain_text, truncated)``. Markup is removed; the result is data, never markup."""
    if value is None:
        return "", False
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} must be text")
    if len(value) > 200_000:
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} is too large")
    parser = _TextExtractor()
    try:
        parser.feed(value)
        parser.close()
    except Exception:  # malformed markup must not crash ingestion
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} could not be parsed") from None
    text = html.unescape("".join(parser.parts))
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text)
    # Drop control and format characters (zero-width, bidi overrides, ...), keep newlines for blocks.
    text = "".join(
        ch if ch == "\n" else (" " if ch == "\t" else ch)
        for ch in text
        if ch in "\n\t" or unicodedata.category(ch) not in {"Cc", "Cf", "Cs", "Co", "Cn"}
    )
    lines = [re.sub(r"[ \u00a0]+", " ", line).strip() for line in text.split("\n")]
    lines = [line for line in lines if line]
    text = ("\n".join(lines)) if multiline else " ".join(lines)
    truncated = len(text) > max_len
    return text[:max_len].rstrip(), truncated


def _price(value: object, field: str) -> str | None:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        value = str(value)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _PRICE_RE.match(value.strip()):
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} is not a valid price")
    try:
        return format(Decimal(value.strip()).normalize(), "f")
    except InvalidOperation:  # pragma: no cover - guarded by regex
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} is not a valid price") from None


def _terms(items: object, field: str, truncated: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    if items is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise ProductValidationError(f"{field} must be a list")
    names: set[str] = set()
    for item in items[: MAX_TERMS * 3]:
        raw = item.get("name") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        text, cut = clean_text(raw, MAX_TERM_LEN, f"{field}.name")
        if cut:
            truncated.add(field)
        if text:
            names.add(text)
    ordered = sorted(names)
    if len(ordered) > MAX_TERMS or len(items) > MAX_TERMS * 3:
        truncated.add(field)
    return ordered[:MAX_TERMS]


def _attributes(items: object, truncated: set[str]) -> list[dict]:
    if items is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise ProductValidationError("attributes must be a list")
    result: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for item in items[: MAX_ATTRIBUTES * 2]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ProductValidationError("attribute entries must be objects")
        name, cut = clean_text(item.get("name"), MAX_TERM_LEN, "attributes.name")
        if cut:
            truncated.add("attributes")
        if not name:
            continue
        raw_options = item.get("options")
        if raw_options is None:
            raw_options = []
        if not isinstance(raw_options, list):
            raise ProductValidationError("attribute options must be a list")
        options: list[str] = []
        for option in raw_options[: MAX_OPTIONS * 2]:
            if isinstance(option, (int, float)) and not isinstance(option, bool):
                option = str(option)
            text, cut = clean_text(option, MAX_OPTION_LEN, "attributes.options")
            if cut:
                truncated.add("attributes")
            if text and text not in options:
                options.append(text)
        if len(options) > MAX_OPTIONS:
            truncated.add("attributes")
        result.setdefault(name, [])
        for option in options[:MAX_OPTIONS]:
            if option not in result[name]:
                result[name].append(option)
    if len(result) > MAX_ATTRIBUTES or len(items) > MAX_ATTRIBUTES * 2:
        truncated.add("attributes")
    return [{"name": name, "options": result[name]} for name in sorted(result)[:MAX_ATTRIBUTES]]


def _same_host_https(url: object, host: str) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(url, str) or len(url) > 500:
        return None
    try:
        validated = validate_endpoint_url(url.rstrip("/") if url.count("/") > 2 else url)
    except UnsafeEndpointError:
        return None
    return url if validated.host == host else None


def normalize_product(raw: object, requested_id: str, *, endpoint_host: str) -> dict:
    """Deterministically map a WooCommerce product to the ProductSnapshot payload.

    Raises ``ProductValidationError`` for anything that cannot be trusted as a product.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ProductValidationError("product payload is not an object")
    if not PRODUCT_ID_RE.match(requested_id or ""):
        raise ProductValidationError("product id must be a positive integer")
    raw_id = raw.get("id")
    if isinstance(raw_id, bool) or str(raw_id) != requested_id:
        raise WooInvalidResponse("response does not match the requested product")

    truncated: set[str] = set()
    name, cut = clean_text(raw.get("name"), MAX_NAME, "name")
    if cut:
        truncated.add("name")
    if len(name) < 2:
        raise ProductValidationError("product name is required")
    sku, cut = clean_text(raw.get("sku"), MAX_SKU, "sku")
    if cut:
        truncated.add("sku")
    description, cut = clean_text(raw.get("description"), MAX_DESCRIPTION, "description", multiline=True)
    if cut:
        truncated.add("description")
    short, cut = clean_text(raw.get("short_description"), MAX_SHORT_DESCRIPTION, "short_description", multiline=True)
    if cut:
        truncated.add("short_description")

    product_type = raw.get("type", "simple")
    if not isinstance(product_type, str) or not _TYPE_RE.match(product_type):
        raise ProductValidationError("product type is invalid")
    status = raw.get("status", "publish")
    if status not in PRODUCT_STATUSES:
        raise ProductValidationError("product status is not eligible for content generation")
    stock = raw.get("stock_status")
    if stock is not None and stock not in STOCK_STATUSES:
        raise ProductValidationError("stock_status is invalid")
    on_sale = raw.get("on_sale")
    if on_sale is not None and not isinstance(on_sale, bool):
        raise ProductValidationError("on_sale must be a boolean")

    data = {
        "source": "woocommerce",
        "external_product_id": requested_id,
        "name": name,
        "sku": sku,
        "type": product_type,
        "status": status,
        "permalink": _same_host_https(raw.get("permalink"), endpoint_host),
        "short_description": short,
        "description": description,
        "price": _price(raw.get("price"), "price"),
        "regular_price": _price(raw.get("regular_price"), "regular_price"),
        "sale_price": _price(raw.get("sale_price"), "sale_price"),
        "on_sale": bool(on_sale),
        "stock_status": stock,
        "categories": _terms(raw.get("categories"), "categories", truncated),
        "tags": _terms(raw.get("tags"), "tags", truncated),
        "attributes": _attributes(raw.get("attributes"), truncated),
        "truncated_fields": sorted(truncated),
        "normalization_version": SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    }
    return data


async def fetch_normalized_product(
    base_url: str,
    consumer_key: str,
    consumer_secret: str,
    product_id: str,
    *,
    resolver: Resolver | None = None,
    transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    sleep=asyncio.sleep,
) -> dict:
    """Retrieve one product and return its validated, normalized snapshot payload."""
    client = WooCommerceClient(
        base_url, consumer_key, consumer_secret, resolver=resolver, transport=transport, sleep=sleep
    )
    raw = await client.get_product(product_id)
    return normalize_product(raw, product_id, endpoint_host=client._endpoint.host)  # noqa: SLF001

"""WooCommerce -> ProductSnapshot -> ProductContentJob (Phase 2 pipeline service).

Transaction model: all network I/O happens with NO open DB transaction. The DB phase (snapshot +
job + content item) is ONE transaction guarded by a transaction-scoped advisory lock keyed on the
logical request, so identical concurrent requests serialize and the loser simply finds the winner's
job. Any failure rolls the whole phase back: no snapshot without a job, no job without a snapshot.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging
import uuid
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import BrandProfile
from app.hardening_domain import ProviderCredential, ProviderCredentialStatus
from app.hardening_services import decrypt_secret
from app.product_domain import ProductContentJob, ProductSnapshot
from app.product_services import canonical_hash, create_product_content_job, get_or_create_snapshot
from app.ssrf import UnsafeEndpointError, validate_endpoint_url
from app.woocommerce import (
    PRODUCT_ID_RE,
    ProductValidationError,
    WooAuthError,
    WooError,
    WooInvalidResponse,
    WooNotFound,
    WooTimeout,
    WooUnreachable,
    WooUnsafeEndpoint,
    parse_consumer_credentials,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("risheh.engage.product_pipeline")

# (base_url, consumer_key, consumer_secret, product_id) -> normalized snapshot payload
ProductFetcher = Callable[[str, str, str, str], Awaitable[dict]]

_HTTP_STATUS = {
    WooUnsafeEndpoint: 422,
    ProductValidationError: 422,
    WooNotFound: 404,
    WooAuthError: 424,
    WooTimeout: 504,
    WooUnreachable: 502,
    WooInvalidResponse: 502,
}


def woo_error_to_http(exc: WooError) -> HTTPException:
    status = next((code for cls, code in _HTTP_STATUS.items() if isinstance(exc, cls)), 502)
    return HTTPException(status_code=status, detail={"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IngestResult:
    job: ProductContentJob
    snapshot: ProductSnapshot
    job_created: bool
    snapshot_created: bool


def job_idempotency_key(credential_id: uuid.UUID, external_product_id: str, source_hash: str) -> str:
    """Same credential + product + identical normalized data == the same logical request."""
    return f"woo:{credential_id}:{external_product_id}:{source_hash}"


def _advisory_key(workspace_id: uuid.UUID, idempotency_key: str) -> int:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{workspace_id}:{idempotency_key}".encode()).digest()
    return int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big", signed=True)


async def ingest_woocommerce_product(
    session: AsyncSession,
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    credential_id: uuid.UUID,
    external_product_id: str,
    fetcher: ProductFetcher,
) -> IngestResult:
    if not PRODUCT_ID_RE.match(external_product_id or ""):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail={"code": "product_validation_failed", "message": "product id must be a positive integer"})

    # ---- 1. server-side ownership checks (workspace comes from the verified membership)
    credential = (
        await session.execute(
            select(ProviderCredential).where(
                ProviderCredential.id == credential_id, ProviderCredential.workspace_id == workspace_id
            )
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if credential is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Credential not found in workspace")
    if credential.provider != "woocommerce" or credential.status != ProviderCredentialStatus.active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="An active woocommerce credential is required")
    base_url = (credential.metadata_json or {}).get("base_url", "")
    secret = credential.encrypted_secret
    brand = (
        await session.execute(select(BrandProfile.id).where(BrandProfile.workspace_id == workspace_id))
    ).first()
    if brand is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="A brand profile is required before product content")
    try:
        validate_endpoint_url(base_url)
    except UnsafeEndpointError as exc:
        raise woo_error_to_http(WooUnsafeEndpoint(exc.reason)) from None

    # ---- 2. release the connection before any network I/O
    await session.rollback()

    # ---- 3. retrieve + normalize + validate (untrusted data)
    try:
        key, value = parse_consumer_credentials(decrypt_secret(secret))
        data = await fetcher(base_url, key, value, external_product_id)
    except WooError as exc:
        logger.warning("woocommerce ingest failed code=%s workspace=%s", exc.code, workspace_id)
        raise woo_error_to_http(exc) from None
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("unexpected woocommerce ingest failure workspace=%s", workspace_id)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={"code": "upstream_error", "message": "unexpected upstream failure"}) from None

    # ---- 4. one atomic DB phase
    idempotency_key = job_idempotency_key(credential_id, external_product_id, canonical_hash(data))
    try:
        await session.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(:k)"), {"k": _advisory_key(workspace_id, idempotency_key)})
        snapshot, snapshot_created = await get_or_create_snapshot(
            session, workspace_id, credential_id, external_product_id, data, commit=False
        )
        job, job_created = await create_product_content_job(
            session, workspace_id, snapshot.id, idempotency_key, created_by_user_id=user_id, commit=False
        )
        await session.commit()
    except BaseException:
        await session.rollback()
        raise
    return IngestResult(job=job, snapshot=snapshot, job_created=job_created, snapshot_created=snapshot_created)
EOF

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.auth import get_current_user, require_roles
from app.database import get_session
from app.domain import Membership, User, WorkspaceRole
from app.product_pipeline import ProductFetcher, ingest_woocommerce_product
from app.woocommerce import fetch_normalized_product

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["product-content"])
EDIT_ROLES = (WorkspaceRole.owner, WorkspaceRole.admin, WorkspaceRole.editor)


class ProductJobRequest(BaseModel):
    # Workspace and user come from the URL membership / JWT; unknown fields are rejected.
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    credential_id: uuid.UUID
    external_product_id: str = Field(pattern=r"^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$")


class ProductJobResponse(BaseModel):
    job_id: uuid.UUID
    status: str
    snapshot_id: uuid.UUID
    content_id: uuid.UUID
    created: bool
    snapshot_created: bool


def get_product_fetcher() -> ProductFetcher:
    """Overridable dependency (tests inject a fake fetcher; production uses the SSRF-safe client)."""
    return fetch_normalized_product


@router.post(
    "/workspaces/{workspace_id}/product-content/jobs",
    response_model=ProductJobResponse,
    status_code=201,
)
async def create_product_content_job_from_woocommerce(
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: ProductJobRequest,
    response: Response,
    _: Membership = Depends(require_roles(*EDIT_ROLES)),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),
    fetcher: ProductFetcher = Depends(get_product_fetcher),
):
    result = await ingest_woocommerce_product(
        session, workspace_id, current_user.id, payload.credential_id, payload.external_product_id, fetcher
    )
    if not result.job_created:
        response.status_code = 200
    return ProductJobResponse(
        job_id=result.job.id,
        status=result.job.status.value,
        snapshot_id=result.snapshot.id,
        content_id=result.job.content_id,
        created=result.job_created,
        snapshot_created=result.snapshot_created,
    )

    with pytest.raises(woo.WooInvalidResponse):

async def test_client_errors_are_not_retried_server_errors_are_bounded():
    calls = []

    def bad_request(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return json_response({"code": "rest_invalid_param"}, 400)

    with pytest.raises(woo.WooUpstreamError):
        await fetch_with(bad_request)
    assert len(calls) == 1

    calls.clear()
    sleeps = []

    async def sleep(s):
        sleeps.append(s)

    def unavailable(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(503, headers={"Retry-After": "999"})

    with pytest.raises(woo.WooUpstreamError):
        await fetch_with(unavailable, sleep=sleep)
    assert len(calls) == woo.MAX_RETRIES + 1 and len(sleeps) == woo.MAX_RETRIES
    assert all(s <= woo.MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS for s in sleeps)  # hostile Retry-After is capped

    assert len(calls) == 2

        for _ in range(woo.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES // 1024 + 2):

    with pytest.raises(woo.WooInvalidResponse):

    blob = " ".join(errors) + repr(client) + caplog.text
    assert SECRET_VALUE not in blob and SECRET_KEY not in blob
    assert woo.parse_consumer_credentials("ck_a:cs_b") == ("ck_a", "cs_b")
    for bad in ("", "nocolon", ":x", "x:"):
        with pytest.raises(woo.WooAuthError):
            woo.parse_consumer_credentials(bad)


# ============================================================================ normalization


def norm(raw=None, pid="42"):
    return woo.normalize_product(RAW if raw is None else raw, pid, endpoint_host=HOST)


def test_normalization_is_deterministic_and_order_insensitive():
    a = norm()
    shuffled = copy.deepcopy(RAW)
    shuffled["categories"].reverse()
    shuffled = dict(reversed(list(shuffled.items())))
    b = norm(shuffled)
    assert a == b and canonical_hash(a) == canonical_hash(b)
    assert a["categories"] == ["Home", "Kitchen"]
    assert a["attributes"] == [{"name": "Color", "options": ["Red", "Blue"]}]
    assert a["price"] == "19.9" and a["regular_price"] == "25" and a["external_product_id"] == "42"
    changed = canonical_hash(norm({**RAW, "price": "20.00", "sale_price": ""}))
    assert changed != canonical_hash(a)


def test_untrusted_markup_and_instructions_stay_inert_plain_text():
    data = norm()
    assert data["name"] == "Ceramic Mug" and data["short_description"] == "Nice mug"
    blob = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "<" not in blob and "alert(1)" not in blob and "\u200b" not in blob
    assert "Ignore previous instructions" in data["description"]  # kept as DATA, never as markup
    hostile = norm({**RAW, "name": "Mug\u202e evil\x00\x07", "description": "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>text &lt;b&gt;"})
    assert "\u202e" not in hostile["name"] and "\x00" not in hostile["name"] and "onerror" not in hostile["description"]


def test_permalink_is_kept_only_for_the_same_https_host():
    assert norm()["permalink"] == f"{BASE}/product/mug/"
    for url in ("https://evil.example.org/x", "http://shop.example.com/x", "javascript:alert(1)", 5, None):
        assert norm({**RAW, "permalink": url})["permalink"] is None


def test_missing_null_and_optional_fields_are_handled():
    minimal = norm({"id": 42, "name": "Plain mug"})
    assert minimal["description"] == "" and minimal["price"] is None and minimal["categories"] == [] and minimal["on_sale"] is False
    nulls = norm({"id": 42, "name": "Plain mug", "description": None, "categories": None, "attributes": None, "price": None})
    assert nulls["attributes"] == [] and nulls["price"] is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("patch", [
    {"name": ""}, {"name": None}, {"name": 5}, {"name": "<script></script>"}, {"name": "x"},
    {"price": "abc"}, {"price": "-5"}, {"price": "1e9"}, {"price": "1" * 20}, {"price": {"a": 1}},
    {"status": "trash"}, {"status": 3}, {"stock_status": "weird"}, {"on_sale": "yes"}, {"type": "Bad Type!"},
    {"description": 12}, {"categories": "x"}, {"attributes": [1]}, {"attributes": [{"name": "a", "options": "x"}]},
    {"description": "x" * 200_001},
])
def test_invalid_untrusted_data_is_rejected(patch):
    with pytest.raises(woo.ProductValidationError):
        norm({**RAW, **patch})


def test_sizes_are_bounded_and_truncation_is_recorded():
    big = {
        **RAW, "name": "N" * 500, "description": "word " * 10_000,
        "categories": [{"name": f"c{i}"} for i in range(100)],
        "attributes": [{"name": f"a{i}", "options": [str(j) for j in range(200)]} for i in range(100)],
    }
    data = norm(big)
    assert len(data["name"]) <= woo.MAX_NAME and len(data["description"]) <= woo.MAX_DESCRIPTION
    assert len(data["categories"]) <= woo.MAX_TERMS and len(data["attributes"]) <= woo.MAX_ATTRIBUTES
    assert all(len(a["options"]) <= woo.MAX_OPTIONS for a in data["attributes"])
    assert {"name", "description", "categories", "attributes"} <= set(data["truncated_fields"])
    assert len(json.dumps(data)) < 256 * 1024


# ============================================================================ DB: snapshot + job ingestion

db = pytest.mark.skipif(not os.getenv("DATABASE_URL"), reason="DATABASE_URL is required")


class FakeWoo:
    def __init__(self, data=None, error=None, delay=0.0):
        self.data, self.error, self.delay, self.calls = data or norm(), error, delay, []

    async def __call__(self, base_url, key, secret, product_id):
        self.calls.append((base_url, key, secret, product_id))
        if self.delay:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return copy.deepcopy(self.data)


async def ingest(sf, w, fetcher, *, product_id="42", credential_id=None, user_id=None):
    async with sf() as s:
        return await ingest_woocommerce_product(
            s, w.workspace_id, user_id or w.user_id, credential_id or w.woo_id, product_id, fetcher
        )


async def counts(sf, w):
    async with sf() as s:
        out = []
        for model in (ProductSnapshot, ProductContentJob, ContentItem):
            out.append((await s.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(model).where(model.workspace_id == w.workspace_id))).scalar_one())
        return tuple(out)


@db
async def test_ingest_creates_snapshot_and_initial_job(sf):
    w, fetcher = await make_world(sf), FakeWoo()
    r = await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
    assert (r.job_created, r.snapshot_created) == (True, True)
    assert fetcher.calls == [(BASE, SECRET_KEY, SECRET_VALUE, "42")]  # decrypted server-side, metadata base_url
    assert r.job.status.value == "queued" and r.job.revision_count == 0 and r.job.attempts == 0
    assert r.job.workspace_id == r.snapshot.workspace_id == w.workspace_id
    assert r.snapshot.credential_id == w.woo_id and r.snapshot.external_product_id == "42"
    assert r.snapshot.source_hash == canonical_hash(fetcher.data)
    assert r.job.idempotency_key == job_idempotency_key(w.woo_id, "42", r.snapshot.source_hash)
    assert r.job.created_by_user_id == w.user_id
    async with sf() as s:
        content = await s.get(ContentItem, r.job.content_id)
    assert content.kind == "product" and content.title == "Ceramic Mug" and content.platform == "wordpress"


@db
async def test_unchanged_product_is_deduplicated_and_changed_product_gets_new_snapshot_and_job(sf):
    w, fetcher = await make_world(sf), FakeWoo()
    first = await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
    again = await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
    assert again.job.id == first.job.id and again.snapshot.id == first.snapshot.id
    assert (again.job_created, again.snapshot_created) == (False, False)
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (1, 1, 1)

    fetcher.data = norm({**RAW, "price": "30.00", "sale_price": ""})
    changed = await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
    assert changed.job_created and changed.snapshot_created
    assert changed.snapshot.id != first.snapshot.id and changed.job.id != first.job.id
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (2, 2, 2)
    async with sf() as s:  # the old snapshot is untouched
        old = await s.get(ProductSnapshot, first.snapshot.id)
    assert old.source_hash == first.snapshot.source_hash and old.data["price"] == "19.9"

    fetcher.data = norm()  # product reverts -> original snapshot and job are reused
    reverted = await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
    assert reverted.job.id == first.job.id and not reverted.job_created
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (2, 2, 2)


@db
async def test_concurrent_duplicate_requests_create_exactly_one_job(sf):
    w, fetcher = await make_world(sf), FakeWoo(delay=0.05)
    results = await asyncio.gather(*[ingest(sf, w, fetcher) for _ in range(8)])
    assert sum(r.job_created for r in results) == 1 and sum(r.snapshot_created for r in results) == 1
    assert len({r.job.id for r in results}) == 1
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (1, 1, 1)


@db
async def test_workspace_isolation_and_credential_ownership(sf):
    a, b = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:  # B uses A's credential
        await ingest(sf, b, FakeWoo(), credential_id=a.woo_id)
    assert exc.value.status_code == 404
    same_a, same_b = FakeWoo(), FakeWoo()
    ra, rb = await ingest(sf, a, same_a), await ingest(sf, b, same_b)  # identical product, different tenants
    assert ra.job.id != rb.job.id and ra.snapshot.id != rb.snapshot.id
    assert await counts(sf, a) == (1, 1, 1) and await counts(sf, b) == (1, 1, 1)
    for tenant in (a, b):
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:  # wordpress credential is not a woocommerce source
            await ingest(sf, tenant, FakeWoo(), credential_id=tenant.wp_id)
        assert exc.value.status_code == 409
    async with sf() as s:
        cred = await s.get(ProviderCredential, a.woo_id)
        cred.status = "disabled"
        await s.commit()
    fetcher = FakeWoo()
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
        await ingest(sf, a, fetcher)
    assert exc.value.status_code == 409 and not fetcher.calls


@db
async def test_unsafe_stored_endpoint_never_reaches_the_network(sf):
    w = await make_world(sf)
    for bad in ("http://shop.example.com", "https://127.0.0.1", "https://localhost", ""):
        async with sf() as s:
            cred = await s.get(ProviderCredential, w.woo_id)
            cred.metadata_json = {"base_url": bad}
            await s.commit()
        fetcher = FakeWoo()
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            await ingest(sf, w, fetcher)
        assert exc.value.status_code == 422 and exc.value.detail["code"] == "unsafe_endpoint" and not fetcher.calls
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (0, 0, 0)


@db
@pytest.mark.parametrize("error,status,code", [
    (woo.WooAuthError("rejected"), 424, "invalid_credentials"),
    (woo.WooTimeout("slow"), 504, "timeout"),
    (woo.WooUnreachable("down"), 502, "unreachable"),
    (woo.WooUnsafeEndpoint("private"), 422, "unsafe_endpoint"),
    (woo.WooInvalidResponse("junk"), 502, "invalid_response"),
    (woo.WooNotFound("missing"), 404, "product_not_found"),
    (woo.ProductValidationError("bad"), 422, "product_validation_failed"),
    (woo.WooUpstreamError("boom"), 502, "upstream_error"),
    (RuntimeError("secret cs_x leaked?"), 502, "upstream_error"),
])
async def test_failures_are_mapped_and_leave_no_partial_state(sf, error, status, code):
    w = await make_world(sf)
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
        await ingest(sf, w, FakeWoo(error=error))
    assert exc.value.status_code == status and exc.value.detail["code"] == code
    assert "cs_x" not in json.dumps(exc.value.detail)
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (0, 0, 0)


@db
async def test_db_phase_is_atomic_snapshot_rolls_back_if_job_creation_fails(sf, monkeypatch):
    w = await make_world(sf)

    async def boom(*args, **kwargs):

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.product_pipeline.create_product_content_job", boom)
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException):
        await ingest(sf, w, FakeWoo())
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (0, 0, 0)


@db
async def test_brand_is_required_before_any_upstream_call(sf):

# ============================================================================ HTTP boundary


def client_for(sf, fetcher):
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(product_router)

    async def _session():
        async with sf() as s:
            yield s

    app.dependency_overrides[get_session] = _session
    app.dependency_overrides[get_product_fetcher] = lambda: fetcher
    return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://t")


async def auth_header(sf, w):
    async with sf() as s:
        return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {create_access_token(await s.get(User, w.user_id))}"}


@db
async def test_endpoint_creates_replays_and_hides_secrets(sf):
    w, fetcher = await make_world(sf), FakeWoo()
    h = await auth_header(sf, w)
    url = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/product-content/jobs"
    body = {"credential_id": str(w.woo_id), "external_product_id": "42"}
    async with client_for(sf, fetcher) as c:
        first = await c.post(url, headers=h, json=body)
        again = await c.post(url, headers=h, json=body)
    assert first.status_code == 201 and again.status_code == 200, first.text
    j1, j2 = first.json(), again.json()
    assert j1["created"] is True and j2["created"] is False and j1["job_id"] == j2["job_id"]
    assert j1["status"] == "queued" and j1["snapshot_created"] is True
    text_out = first.text + again.text
    assert SECRET_VALUE not in text_out and "encrypted" not in text_out and "ck_x" not in text_out


@db
async def test_endpoint_authentication_authorization_and_input_control(sf):
    w, outsider = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)
    fetcher = FakeWoo()
    url = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/product-content/jobs"
    body = {"credential_id": str(w.woo_id), "external_product_id": "42"}
    async with sf() as s:
        viewer = User(email=f"v-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com", password_hash="x", full_name="Viewer")
        s.add(viewer)
        await s.flush()
        s.add(Membership(workspace_id=w.workspace_id, user_id=viewer.id, role=WorkspaceRole.viewer))
        await s.commit()
        viewer_header = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {create_access_token(viewer)}"}
    async with client_for(sf, fetcher) as c:
        assert (await c.post(url, json=body)).status_code == 401
        assert (await c.post(url, headers=await auth_header(sf, outsider), json=body)).status_code == 403
        assert (await c.post(url, headers=viewer_header, json=body)).status_code == 403
        h = await auth_header(sf, w)
        for extra in ({"workspace_id": str(outsider.workspace_id)}, {"created_by_user_id": str(outsider.user_id)}, {"base_url": "https://evil.example.org"}):
            assert (await c.post(url, headers=h, json={**body, **extra})).status_code == 422
        for pid in ("0", "abc", "1/../2", "", "9" * 13):
            assert (await c.post(url, headers=h, json={**body, "external_product_id": pid})).status_code == 422
        # outsider's own workspace + insider's credential -> credential is not theirs
        own = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{outsider.workspace_id}/product-content/jobs"
        assert (await c.post(own, headers=await auth_header(sf, outsider), json=body)).status_code == 404
    assert not fetcher.calls
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (0, 0, 0) and await counts(sf, outsider) == (0, 0, 0)


@db
async def test_endpoint_maps_upstream_errors(sf):
    w = await make_world(sf)
    h = await auth_header(sf, w)
    url = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/product-content/jobs"
    body = {"credential_id": str(w.woo_id), "external_product_id": "42"}
    async with client_for(sf, FakeWoo(error=woo.WooAuthError("rejected"))) as c:
        r = await c.post(url, headers=h, json=body)
    assert r.status_code == 424 and r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "invalid_credentials"
    async with client_for(sf, FakeWoo(error=woo.WooNotFound("missing"))) as c:
        assert (await c.post(url, headers=h, json=body)).status_code == 404
    assert await counts(sf, w) == (0, 0, 0)

- Secret ذخیره‌شده: JSON `{"consumer_key","consumer_secret"}` (فرم قدیمی `key:secret` هم خوانده می‌شود)؛ `metadata.base_url` باید https باشد.

- هنوز نیست: AI/validation/revision (Phase 3)، pagination فهرست محصولات (برای دریافت تکی لازم نیست)، rate limit (Phase 7).

# Phase 3 — AI Generation, Validation, Quality & Bounded Revision

Implement only Phase 3.

IMPORTANT:
- Optimize for context/token efficiency.
- Do NOT rescan the repository.
- Do NOT re-audit Phase 0, Phase 1, or Phase 2.
- Inspect only the existing AI/provider code and the Phase 1/2 services/models directly required by this phase.
- Do not repeat previous architecture findings.
- Do not inspect unchanged files without a concrete dependency.
- Do not start Phase 4.

## Scope

Implement the Product Content pipeline:

ProductContentJob
→ AI Generation
→ Deterministic Validation
→ AI Quality Review
→ bounded Revision
→ ready_for_review / terminal failure

AI is never authoritative.

AI must NOT control:
- authorization
- workspace ownership
- credentials
- publication
- idempotency
- retry limits
- revision limits
- state transitions

## 1. AI Generation

Reuse the existing AI/provider abstraction where suitable.

Implement Product Content generation using the existing provider architecture.

Requirements:

- authenticated workspace context
- safe provider/credential selection
- bounded input size
- bounded output size
- explicit model/prompt version metadata
- timeout handling
- controlled transient retries
- no secrets in prompts/logs/errors
- treat WooCommerce/product data as untrusted data
- defend against prompt injection contained in product fields
- AI output is untrusted

Persist generated output as an immutable ContentVersion.

Do not overwrite an existing immutable version.

## 2. Deterministic Validation

Implement deterministic validation BEFORE AI quality approval.

Validation must be independent of the AI evaluator.

Validate at minimum:

- required fields
- allowed content structure
- maximum lengths
- empty/invalid content
- prohibited unsafe output where applicable
- expected language/format constraints
- malformed output
- content hash consistency

Validation results must be stored against the specific ContentVersion.

Invalid content must never bypass validation because an AI evaluator considers it good.

## 3. AI Quality Review

Implement an AI quality evaluator using the existing provider abstraction.

The evaluator may assess content quality, but its result is advisory and must remain separate from deterministic validation.

Store a version-specific quality report containing at minimum:

- score/result
- structured issues
- model/provider metadata
- prompt version

Never allow the evaluator to directly authorize publication.

## 4. Bounded Revision

If validation or quality review requires revision:

- create a NEW ContentVersion
- never mutate the previous version
- increment the ProductContentJob revision count
- enforce the hard maximum revision limit server-side
- prevent concurrent revision races
- re-run deterministic validation after every revision
- re-run quality review after every revision when applicable

If the maximum revision count is reached:

- stop revision
- move the job to the appropriate terminal/attention state
- preserve all versions and reports
- do not loop indefinitely

AI output must never decide its own revision limit.

## 5. State Integrity

Use the existing ProductContentJob state machine from Phase 1.

Enforce transitions server-side.

A job must not advance to review-ready unless:

1. a valid ContentVersion exists
2. deterministic validation passes
3. required quality evaluation has completed successfully according to the implemented policy
4. revision limits have not been violated

Use transactional locking/atomic updates where required.

Do not invent a second state machine.

## 6. Idempotency & Concurrency

Use the Phase 1/2 idempotency design.

Ensure:

- duplicate generation requests do not create uncontrolled duplicate work
- concurrent workers cannot exceed revision limits
- the same job cannot be revised twice concurrently
- immutable versions remain auditable
- retries do not corrupt job state

Do not redesign existing idempotency unless a concrete Phase 3 dependency requires it.

## 7. Tests

Add only focused Phase 3 tests:

- AI generation
- provider failure/timeout
- untrusted/prompt-injection product data
- deterministic validation
- invalid AI output
- quality evaluation
- version immutability
- revision creation
- hard revision limit
- state transition integrity
- idempotency
- concurrent revision protection
- workspace isolation
- regression tests for existing AI behavior

Do not implement Phase 4+ tests.

## Restrictions

Do NOT implement:

- human review UI/API beyond what is strictly required for the existing state transition
- WordPress
- publication execution
- n8n
- Telegram
- new frontend features
- Phase 7 security hardening unrelated to this pipeline
- Phase 8 E2E
- unrelated refactors

## Completion

Run focused Phase 3 tests and relevant regression tests.

Verify:
- AI remains untrusted
- deterministic validation remains authoritative
- versions are immutable
- revision limit is backend-enforced
- concurrent revisions cannot bypass the limit
- no future-phase functionality was added

Keep the final response minimal.

Do not provide a report.
Do not repeat previous findings.
Do not summarize unchanged architecture.

After successful completion, respond exactly:

Phase 3 complete.

If genuinely blocked:

Phase 3 complete — blocker: <short concrete description>.

STOP.

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import httpx
from fastapi import HTTPException

from app.settings import settings


INTENTS = [
    "general_question",
    "price_request",
    "sales_interest",
    "support",
    "complaint",
    "refund",
    "financial_commitment",
    "legal_commitment",
    "security_issue",
    "spam",
]


class AIUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    pass


class AITransientError(AIUnavailable):
    """Timeout / network failure / HTTP 408, 429, 5xx: safe to retry a bounded number of times."""


def _require_ai_config() -> None:
    if not settings.ai_api_base_url or not settings.ai_api_key or not settings.ai_model:
        raise AIUnavailable("AI provider is not configured")


async def _chat(
    messages: list[dict[str, str]], *, temperature: float = 0.1, max_tokens: int | None = None
) -> str:
    _require_ai_config()
    url = f"{settings.ai_api_base_url.rstrip('/')}/chat/completions"
    payload = {
        "model": settings.ai_model,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
    }
    if max_tokens is not None:
        payload["max_tokens"] = max_tokens
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.ai_api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=settings.ai_timeout_seconds) as client:
            response = await client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    except (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.TransportError):
        raise AITransientError("AI provider timed out or was unreachable") from None
    if response.status_code in (408, 429) or response.status_code >= 500:
        raise AITransientError(f"AI provider returned HTTP {response.status_code}")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AIUnavailable(f"AI provider returned HTTP {response.status_code}")
    try:
        return response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise AIUnavailable("AI provider response shape is invalid") from exc


async def classify_intent(message: str) -> tuple[str, int, str]:
    prompt = (
        "You classify customer-service messages. Return JSON only with keys intent, confidence, reason. "
        f"intent must be one of: {', '.join(INTENTS)}. confidence is integer 0..100. "
        "Never invent customer facts. If ambiguous, lower confidence."
    )
    raw = await _chat([
        {"role": "system", "content": prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": message},
    ])
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
        intent = str(data["intent"]).strip().lower()
        confidence = int(data["confidence"])
        reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))[:1000]
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise AIUnavailable("AI classifier returned invalid JSON") from exc
    if intent not in INTENTS or not 0 <= confidence <= 100:
        raise AIUnavailable("AI classifier returned out-of-contract values")
    return intent, confidence, reason

"""Deterministic validation of generated product content (authoritative; never AI-decided).

The result is stored on the exact ``ContentVersion`` it judged and is bound to its content hash.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
