BASE = "https://blog.example.com"
HOST = "blog.example.com"
PASSWORD = "app-password"  # stored by tests.conftest.make_world as "user:app-password"
PUBLIC = ["93.184.216.34"]


async def public_resolver(host, port):
    return PUBLIC


async def no_sleep(_):
    return None


# ============================================================================ fake WordPress


class FakeWP:
    def __init__(self, link_host=HOST, delay=0.0):
        self.posts, self.calls, self.link_host, self.delay = [], [], link_host, delay
        self.auth_ok, self.lookup_failures, self.post_modes, self.last_auth = True, 0, [], None
        self.bodies = []

    @property
    def gets(self):
        return [c for c in self.calls if c[0] == "GET"]

    @property
    def posts_made(self):
        return [c for c in self.calls if c[0] == "POST"]

    def _store(self, body):
        slug = body["slug"]
        if any(p["slug"] == slug for p in self.posts):  # real WordPress de-duplicates with a numeric suffix
            slug += "-2"
        post = {"id": 100 + len(self.posts), "slug": slug, "status": "publish", "link": f"https://{self.link_host}/{slug}/"}
        self.posts.append(post)
        return post

    async def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self.calls.append((request.method, str(request.url)))
        self.last_auth = request.headers.get("authorization")
        if self.delay:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
        if not self.auth_ok:
            return httpx.Response(401, json={"code": "rest_cannot_create"})
        if request.method == "GET":
            if self.lookup_failures:
                self.lookup_failures -= 1 if self.lookup_failures > 0 else 0
                return httpx.Response(503)
            slug = request.url.params.get("slug")
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[p for p in self.posts if p["slug"] == slug])
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        self.bodies.append(body)
        mode = self.post_modes.pop(0) if self.post_modes else "ok"
        if mode == "timeout_after_create":
            self._store(body)
            raise httpx.ReadTimeout("response lost", request=request)
        if mode == "timeout_before_create":
            raise httpx.ReadTimeout("slow", request=request)
        if mode == "503":
            return httpx.Response(503)
        if mode == "garbage":
            self._store(body)
            return httpx.Response(201, content=b"<html>created?</html>")
        if mode == "400":
            return httpx.Response(400, json={"code": "rest_invalid_param"})
        return httpx.Response(201, json=self._store(body))

    def factory(self):
        def make(base_url, username, password):
            return wp.WordPressClient(base_url, username, password, resolver=public_resolver,
                                      transport=httpx.MockTransport(self.handler), sleep=no_sleep)
        return make


def client(fake, **kw):
    return wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "user", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(fake.handler), sleep=no_sleep, **kw)


# ============================================================================ WordPress client (no DB)


async def test_request_shape_and_authentication():
    fake = FakeWP()
    c = client(fake)
    assert await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-abc") == []
    post = await c.create_post({"title": "t", "slug": "rp-abc"})
    assert post == {"id": 100, "slug": "rp-abc", "url": f"https://{HOST}/rp-abc/", "status": "publish"}
    expected = "Basic " + base64.b64encode(f"user:{PASSWORD}".encode()).decode()
    assert fake.last_auth == expected
    method, url = fake.calls[0]
    req = httpx.URL(url)
    assert req.path == "/wp-json/wp/v2/posts" and req.params["slug"] == "rp-abc" and req.params["status"] == "any"
    assert PASSWORD not in url


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status,body,error", [
    (401, {}, wp.WPAuthError), (403, {}, wp.WPAuthError), (400, {"code": "rest_invalid_param"}, wp.WPRejected),
    (422, {}, wp.WPRejected), (404, {"code": "rest_no_route"}, wp.WPRejected), (404, {}, wp.WPRejected),
])
async def test_permanent_errors_are_typed_and_not_retried(status, body, error):
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(status, json=body)

    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), sleep=no_sleep)
    with pytest.raises(error) as exc:
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    assert len(calls) == 1 and exc.value.permanent is True


async def test_lookup_retries_transient_failures_in_a_bounded_way():
    fake = FakeWP()
    fake.lookup_failures = 2
    assert await client(fake).find_posts_by_slug("rp-x") == []
    assert len(fake.gets) == 3
    fake2 = FakeWP()
    fake2.lookup_failures = -1  # forever
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPUpstreamError):
        await client(fake2).find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    assert len(fake2.gets) == wp.MAX_GET_RETRIES + 1

    def timeout(request):
        raise httpx.ReadTimeout("slow", request=request)

    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(timeout), sleep=no_sleep)
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPTimeout):
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")

    def refused(request):
        raise httpx.ConnectError("no", request=request)

    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(refused), sleep=no_sleep)
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPUnreachable):
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode,error", [("503", wp.WPUpstreamError), ("timeout_before_create", wp.WPTimeout), ("garbage", wp.WPInvalidResponse)])
async def test_create_is_single_shot_unknown_outcomes_are_transient(mode, error):
    fake = FakeWP()
    fake.post_modes = [mode]
    with pytest.raises(error) as exc:
        await client(fake).create_post({"title": "t", "slug": "rp-x"})
    assert len(fake.posts_made) == 1 and exc.value.permanent is False  # the client never repeats a POST itself


async def test_redirects_unsafe_endpoints_and_private_dns_are_refused():
    seen = []

    def redirect(request):
        seen.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(302, headers={"Location": "http://169.254.169.254/"})

    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(redirect), sleep=no_sleep)
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPUnsafeEndpoint):
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    assert len(seen) == 1
    for bad in ("http://blog.example.com", "https://localhost", "https://127.0.0.1", "https://blog.example.com:8443", ""):
        with pytest.raises(wp.WPUnsafeEndpoint):
            wp.WordPressClient(bad, "u", PASSWORD)

    async def private(host, port):
        return ["10.0.0.5"]

    fake = FakeWP()
    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=private, transport=httpx.MockTransport(fake.handler))
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPUnsafeEndpoint):
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    assert not fake.calls


async def test_untrusted_wordpress_responses_are_bounded_and_validated():
    big = lambda r: httpx.Response(200, content=b"[" + b" " * (wp.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1) + b"]")
    c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver, transport=httpx.MockTransport(big), sleep=no_sleep)
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPInvalidResponse):
        await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    for payload in ({"not": "a list"}, [{"id": "7", "slug": "a"}], [{"id": True, "slug": "a"}], [{"id": 5}], [1], [{"id": -1, "slug": "a"}]):
        c = wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD, resolver=public_resolver,
                               transport=httpx.MockTransport(lambda r, p=payload: httpx.Response(200, json=p)), sleep=no_sleep)
        with pytest.raises(wp.WPInvalidResponse):
            await c.find_posts_by_slug("rp-x")
    fake = FakeWP(link_host="evil.example.org")  # a foreign-host link is dropped, the id is kept
    post = await client(fake).create_post({"title": "t", "slug": "rp-x"})
    assert post["url"] is None and post["id"] == 100
    with pytest.raises(wp.WPRejected):
        await client(FakeWP()).create_post({"content": "x" * (wp.MAX_REQUEST_BYTES + 10)})


def test_marker_is_deterministic_and_target_specific():
    a, b, c = (uuid.uuid4() for _ in range(3))
    assert wp.post_marker(a, b, c) == wp.post_marker(a, b, c)
    assert len({wp.post_marker(a, b, c), wp.post_marker(a, c, b), wp.post_marker(b, b, c)}) == 3
    assert len(wp.post_marker(a, b, c)) == 33


def test_credential_parsing_and_secret_hygiene(caplog):
    assert wp.parse_wordpress_credentials("user:abcd efgh") == ("user", "abcd efgh")
    assert wp.parse_wordpress_credentials('{"username": "u", "application_password": "p p"}') == ("u", "p p")
    for bad in ("", "nocolon", ":p", "u:", "{}", "{bad", '{"username": 1, "application_password": "x"}'):
        with pytest.raises(wp.WPAuthError):
            wp.parse_wordpress_credentials(bad)
    assert PASSWORD not in repr(wp.WordPressClient(BASE, "u", PASSWORD))


# ============================================================================ review + authorization (DB)


def api_client(sf, *routers, fake=None):
    app = FastAPI()
    for r in routers:
        app.include_router(r)

    async def _session():
        async with sf() as s:
            yield s

    app.dependency_overrides[get_session] = _session
    app.dependency_overrides[get_session_factory] = lambda: sf
    if fake is not None:
        app.dependency_overrides[get_wordpress_client_factory] = lambda: fake.factory()
    return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://t")


async def hdr(sf, w):
    async with sf() as s:
        return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {create_access_token(await s.get(User, w.user_id))}"}


def key():
    return f"key-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"


async def ready_job(sf, w):
    job = await make_job(sf, w)
    done = await gen.run_product_job(sf, w.workspace_id, job.id, FakeAI())
    assert done.status == J.ready_for_review
    async with sf() as s:
        content = await s.get(ContentItem, job.content_id)
    return job, content.current_version_id


async def approved(sf, w):
    job, version_id = await ready_job(sf, w)
    async with api_client(sf, core_router) as c:
        r = await c.post(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/contents/{job.content_id}/approve", headers=await hdr(sf, w),
                         json={"actor": "Mallory", "content_version_id": str(version_id)})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return job, version_id


async def requested(sf, w, idem=None):
    job, version_id = await approved(sf, w)
    async with api_client(sf, core_router) as c:
        r = await c.post(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/contents/{job.content_id}/publish", headers=await hdr(sf, w),
                         json={"idempotency_key": idem or key(), "credential_id": str(w.wp_id)})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return job, version_id, uuid.UUID(r.json()["id"])


async def pub(sf, pid):
    async with sf() as s:
        return await s.get(Publication, pid)


async def content_of(sf, job):
    async with sf() as s:
        return await s.get(ContentItem, job.content_id)


async def job_of(sf, job):
    async with sf() as s:
        return await s.get(ProductContentJob, job.id)


@db
async def test_review_is_authenticated_version_bound_and_workspace_isolated(sf):
    w, other = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)
    job, version_id = await ready_job(sf, w)
    base = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/contents/{job.content_id}"
    other_job, other_version = await ready_job(sf, other)
    async with api_client(sf, core_router) as c:
        h = await hdr(sf, w)
        assert (await c.post(f"{base}/approve", json={"content_version_id": str(version_id)})).status_code == 401
        assert (await c.post(f"{base}/approve", headers=await hdr(sf, other), json={"content_version_id": str(version_id)})).status_code == 403
        # another tenant's version / content cannot be approved through this workspace
        assert (await c.post(f"{base}/approve", headers=h, json={"content_version_id": str(other_version)})).status_code == 404
        cross = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/contents/{other_job.content_id}/approve"
        assert (await c.post(cross, headers=h, json={"content_version_id": str(other_version)})).status_code == 404
        assert (await c.post(f"{base}/approve", headers=h, json={"actor": "Mallory", "content_version_id": str(version_id)})).status_code == 200
    async with sf() as s:
        a = (await s.execute(select(Approval).where(Approval.content_id == job.content_id))).scalar_one()
    assert a.approver_user_id == w.user_id and a.content_version_id == version_id and a.actor != "Mallory"
    assert (await content_of(sf, job)).status == ContentStatus.approved

@db
async def test_publication_authorization_matrix(sf):
    w, other = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)

    async def fresh(validation, quality, approval=("approved", True), name="x"):
        job = await make_job(sf, w, source={"name": f"{name} {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}", "price": "199000"})
        async with sf() as s:
            v = await add_content_version(s, w.workspace_id, job.content_id, source=ContentVersionSource.ai_generation,
                                          payload=GOOD, model="m", prompt_version="p")
        if validation is not None or quality is not None:
            async with sf() as s:
                await attach_version_reports(s, w.workspace_id, v.id, validation_report=validation, quality_report=quality)
        if approval:
            async with sf() as s:
                s.add(Approval(workspace_id=w.workspace_id, content_id=job.content_id, content_version_id=v.id,
                               decision=approval[0], actor="x", approver_user_id=w.user_id if approval[1] else None))
                await s.commit()
        return job, v

    ok_v = {"passed": True, "content_hash": canonical_hash(GOOD)}
    ok_q = {"acceptable": True, "content_hash": canonical_hash(GOOD)}

    async def check(job, version_id, cred=None, ws=None):
        async with sf() as s:
            content = await s.get(ContentItem, job.content_id)
            return await authorize_product_publication(s, ws or w.workspace_id, content, version_id, cred or w.wp_id)

    job, v = await fresh(ok_v, ok_q)
    assert (await check(job, v.id))[0] == v.id
    for args, code in (
        (dict(validation=None, quality=None), 409),  # no reports
        (dict(validation={"passed": False}, quality=ok_q), 409),
        (dict(validation=ok_v, quality={"acceptable": False}), 409),  # AI/policy rejected quality
        (dict(validation={"passed": True, "content_hash": "0" * 64}, quality=ok_q), 409),  # report bound to other content
        (dict(validation=ok_v, quality=ok_q, approval=None), 409),  # no human approval
        (dict(validation=ok_v, quality=ok_q, approval=("rejected", True)), 409),
        (dict(validation=ok_v, quality=ok_q, approval=("approved", False)), 409),  # not attributable to a user
    ):
        j, version = await fresh(**args)
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            await check(j, version.id)
        assert exc.value.status_code == code, args
    # a later rejection supersedes an earlier approval
    async with sf() as s:
        s.add(Approval(workspace_id=w.workspace_id, content_id=job.content_id, content_version_id=v.id,
                       decision="rejected", actor="x", approver_user_id=w.user_id))
        await s.commit()
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException):
        await check(job, v.id)
    j2, v2 = await fresh(ok_v, ok_q)
    for kwargs in (dict(cred=other.wp_id), dict(cred=w.woo_id), dict(ws=other.workspace_id)):
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            await check(j2, v2.id, **kwargs)
        assert exc.value.status_code in {404, 409}
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException):  # a version that is not the current one
        await check(j2, uuid.uuid4())

@db
async def test_if_reconciliation_is_impossible_nothing_is_created_and_it_stays_retryable(sf):
    w, fake = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    fake.post_modes = ["timeout_after_create"]
    _, _, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    real_lookup = FakeWP.handler
    state = {"fail": False}

    async def flaky(request):  # lookups start failing right after the ambiguous POST
        if request.method == "GET" and state["fail"]:
            fake.calls.append(("GET", str(request.url)))
            return httpx.Response(503)
        resp = await real_lookup(fake, request) if False else None
        return resp

    original = fake.handler

    async def handler(request):
        if request.method == "POST":
            state["fail"] = True
        if request.method == "GET" and state["fail"]:
            fake.calls.append(("GET", str(request.url)))
            return httpx.Response(503)
        return await original(request)

    fake.handler = handler
    first = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    assert first.status == PublicationStatus.pending and first.error_code == "upstream_error"
    assert first.lease_expires_at is None and first.attempt_count == 1
    assert len(fake.posts_made) == 1  # NO second POST was attempted while the outcome was unknown
    state["fail"] = False  # WordPress recovers
    second = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    assert second.status == PublicationStatus.published and second.attempt_count == 2 and second.error_code is None
    assert len(fake.posts) == 1 and len(fake.posts_made) == 1  # reconciled, never duplicated


@db
async def test_crash_after_remote_creation_is_resumed_by_reconciliation(sf, monkeypatch):
    w, fake = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    job, _, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    real = wpp._persist_success

    async def crash(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("process died after WordPress answered")

    monkeypatch.setattr(wpp, "_persist_success", crash)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    p = await pub(sf, pid)
    assert p.status == PublicationStatus.pending and p.lease_expires_at is not None and len(fake.posts) == 1
    monkeypatch.setattr(wpp, "_persist_success", real)
    busy = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)  # the lease is still valid: no concurrent work
    assert busy.status == PublicationStatus.pending and len(fake.calls) == 2
    async with sf() as s:
        await s.execute(text("UPDATE publications SET lease_expires_at = now() - interval '1 second' WHERE id = :i"), {"i": pid})
        await s.commit()
    done = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    assert done.status == PublicationStatus.published and done.external_id == "100" and done.attempt_count == 2
    assert len(fake.posts) == 1 and len(fake.posts_made) == 1
    assert (await content_of(sf, job)).status == ContentStatus.published


@db
async def test_transient_failures_remain_retryable_then_exhaust(sf):
    w, fake = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    job, _, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    fake.post_modes = ["503"] * wpp.MAX_REMOTE_ROUNDS
    first = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    assert first.status == PublicationStatus.pending and first.error_code == "upstream_error" and first.attempt_count == 1
    assert (await content_of(sf, job)).status == ContentStatus.publish_requested and len(fake.posts) == 0
    ok = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)  # later retry succeeds
    assert ok.status == PublicationStatus.published and ok.attempt_count == 2 and ok.error_code is None

    w2, fake2 = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    fake2.post_modes = ["503"] * 100
    job2, _, pid2 = await requested(sf, w2)
    for _ in range(wpp.MAX_ATTEMPTS):
        last = await run(sf, w2, pid2, fake2)
    assert last.status == PublicationStatus.failed and last.error_code == "retries_exhausted"
    assert (await content_of(sf, job2)).status == ContentStatus.failed and len(fake2.posts) == 0
    assert len(fake2.posts_made) <= wpp.MAX_ATTEMPTS * wpp.MAX_REMOTE_ROUNDS

async def test_permanent_failures_are_terminal_and_not_retried(sf):
    w, fake = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    job, version_id, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    fake.auth_ok = False
    done = await run(sf, w, pid, fake)
    assert done.status == PublicationStatus.failed and done.error_code == "invalid_credentials" and done.attempt_count == 1
    assert done.lease_expires_at is None and (await content_of(sf, job)).status == ContentStatus.failed
    assert (await job_of(sf, job)).status == J.ready_for_review  # not completed
    calls = len(fake.calls)
    assert (await run(sf, w, pid, fake)).status == PublicationStatus.failed and len(fake.calls) == calls  # terminal: no retry

    # after the credential is fixed a NEW request key republishes; the deterministic marker prevents duplicates
    fake.auth_ok = True
    fake.posts.append({"id": 555, "slug": wp.post_marker(w.workspace_id, version_id, w.wp_id), "status": "publish",
                       "link": f"https://{HOST}/old/"})
    async with api_client(sf, core_router) as c:

                         json={"idempotency_key": key(), "credential_id": str(w.wp_id)})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    again = await run(sf, w, uuid.UUID(r.json()["id"]), fake)
    assert again.status == PublicationStatus.published and again.external_id == "555" and len(fake.posts_made) == 0

    w3, fake3 = await make_world(sf), FakeWP()
    _, _, pid3 = await requested(sf, w3)
    fake3.post_modes = ["400"]
    rejected = await run(sf, w3, pid3, fake3)

## Phase 4 — بازبینی انسانی و انتشار WordPress (پیاده‌سازی‌شده؛ migration `0007`)
- **مجوز انتشار** (`services.authorize_product_publication`، هم هنگام درخواست و هم هنگام اجرا): نسخه‌ی دقیقاً جاری، validation قطعی موفق، کیفیت `acceptable` (سیاست backend)، و **آخرین** تصمیم انسانی = approve توسط کاربر احراز‌شده؛ credential فعال `wordpress` همان workspace. تأیید (approve) هم کیفیت را الزامی می‌کند. وضعیت از کلاینت پذیرفته نمی‌شود. callback قدیمی n8n نمی‌تواند publication محصول را `published` کند.
- **اجرا**: `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/publications/{id}/execute` (owner/admin/reviewer) ⇒ `wordpress_publication.publish_product_version` (Phase 5 همین تابع را از worker صدا می‌زند). فقط `Publication.status` موجود (pending/published/failed) + دفتر تلاش‌ها روی همان ردیف: `attempt_count`, `lease_expires_at`, `last_attempt_at`, `remote_marker`.
- **عدم تکرار**: (۱) unique `(workspace, idempotency_key)` و حداکثر یک publication زنده برای `(workspace, version, credential)`؛ (۲) lease زیر قفل ردیف؛ (۳) **reconcile قبل از هر POST**: جستجوی WordPress با slug قطعی `rp-<sha256(ws:version:credential)>`. POSTی که نتیجه‌اش نامعلوم است (timeout/5xx/پاسخ نامعتبر) هرگز قبل از lookup تکرار نمی‌شود؛ اگر lookup هم ممکن نباشد چیزی ساخته نمی‌شود و publication `pending` (قابل retry) می‌ماند. دو پست با marker یکسان ⇒ `failed` (`reconciliation_ambiguous`).
- **خطاها**: 401/403/4xx/endpoint ناامن ⇒ `failed` (بدون retry، محتوا `failed` و با کلید جدید قابل انتشار مجدد)؛ timeout/429/5xx ⇒ `pending` با حداکثر `MAX_ATTEMPTS=5`، سپس `retries_exhausted`. موفقیت ⇒ `external_id` الزامی (CHECK در DB)، `external_url` فقط اگر https و هم‌host باشد، محتوا `published`، job `completed`.
- محدودیت: فقط REST با permalink زیبا (`/wp-json`)؛ زمان‌بندی retry خودکار با outbox/worker در Phase 5.

# Phase 5 — Outbox, Worker, n8n & Telegram

Implement only Phase 5.

Optimize for context/token efficiency:
- Do not rescan the repository.
- Do not re-audit Phases 0–4.
- Inspect only the existing outbox, worker, n8n workflows, Telegram integration, and their direct dependencies.
- Verify prior-phase contracts only where this phase depends on them.
- Do not repeat previous findings or inspect unchanged files without a concrete reason.
- Do not start Phase 6.

## Scope

Connect the existing application publication lifecycle to the reliable event pipeline:

Application → Transactional Outbox → Worker → n8n → Telegram

Reuse existing infrastructure; avoid duplicate event or publication systems.

## 1. Transactional Outbox

Ensure relevant events are written transactionally with their business-state changes.

Requirements:
- stable event IDs and idempotency
- workspace-aware event ownership where applicable
- safe duplicate-event handling
- validated event types and payloads
- no credentials, secrets, or unnecessary sensitive content in events
- preserve existing Social/CRM event behavior

Do not create a second outbox.

## 2. Worker Reliability

Extend the existing worker only as needed.

Implement or correct:
- explicit event-handler registry
- rejection/dead-lettering of unknown event types; never default unknown events to publication
- bounded retries with backoff
- safe locking/lease recovery
- concurrent duplicate-processing protection
- accurate success/failure acknowledgement
- recoverable dead-letter state and useful sanitized diagnostics

Do not mark an event successful before its required action succeeds.

Do not let stale-lock recovery and batch processing cause duplicate business actions.

## 3. n8n Integration

Reuse existing workflow conventions and webhook contracts.

Requirements:
- authenticated webhook requests
- request signing or equivalent replay protection where supported by the existing design
- timestamp/nonce validation where applicable
- strict payload validation
- bounded timeouts and safe retry behavior
- idempotent event handling
- no secrets in workflow data or logs

Do not trust n8n payloads as authorization decisions. The application remains the source of truth.

## 4. Telegram

Implement or extend only the Telegram behavior required by the existing publication/event flow.

Requirements:
- secure bot-token handling
- validate destinations and payloads
- handle rate limits and transient failures
- avoid duplicate sends on retries where reliable deduplication is possible
- sanitize logs and errors
- distinguish permanent from transient failures

Do not claim exactly-once delivery where Telegram cannot guarantee it. Handle ambiguous outcomes safely and document the limitation briefly.

## 5. Failure Recovery

Verify behavior for:
- duplicate events
- worker restart
- expired leases
- n8n timeout
- invalid signatures or replayed requests
- Telegram rate limits
- permanent provider failures
- exhausted retries and dead-letter recovery

Preserve business-state consistency across retries and partial failures.

## 6. Tests

Add focused Phase 5 tests for:
- transactional outbox behavior
- handler registry and unknown events
- retries/backoff
- locking and lease recovery
- duplicate processing
- webhook authentication/replay protection
- payload validation
- Telegram transient/permanent failures
- dead-lettering and recovery
- existing Social/CRM regressions

Do not implement Phase 6+ tests.

## Restrictions

Do NOT implement:
- new frontend features
- unrelated API redesign
- AI pipeline changes unrelated to event delivery
- unrelated credential redesign
- Phase 7 broad hardening
- Phase 8 full E2E
- unrelated refactors

Do not start Phase 6.

## Completion

Run focused Phase 5 tests and relevant regression tests.

Verify event idempotency, worker recovery, webhook security, and failure handling. Do not claim exactly-once external delivery without evidence.

Keep the final response minimal. Do not provide a long report or repeat previous findings.

On success, respond exactly:
Phase 5 complete.

If genuinely blocked:
Phase 5 complete — blocker: <short concrete description>.

STOP.

"""HMAC request signing with timestamp + nonce, used for app -> n8n webhooks.

Signed string:  ``v1:{timestamp}.{nonce}.{canonical_json_body}``  (HMAC-SHA256, hex).
The n8n workflow re-creates the canonical JSON from the parsed body and verifies signature, a +-300s
timestamp window and nonce freshness (replay protection). The shared secret is never sent in the request.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import time
from collections import OrderedDict

TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300
HEADER_TIMESTAMP, HEADER_NONCE, HEADER_SIGNATURE = "X-Engage-Timestamp", "X-Engage-Nonce", "X-Engage-Signature"


class WebhookAuthError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, reason: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(reason)
        self.reason = reason


def canonical_body(document: dict) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def compute_signature(secret: str, timestamp: int, nonce: str, body: bytes) -> str:
    message = f"v1:{timestamp}.{nonce}.".encode() + body
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def sign_headers(secret: str, nonce: str, body: bytes, *, now: float | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    timestamp = int(now if now is not None else time.time())
    return {
        HEADER_TIMESTAMP: str(timestamp),
        HEADER_NONCE: nonce,
        HEADER_SIGNATURE: compute_signature(secret, timestamp, nonce, body),
    }


class NonceStore:
    """Bounded in-memory replay cache (reference implementation of what the n8n workflow does)."""

    def __init__(self, max_entries: int = 10_000) -> None:
        self._seen: OrderedDict[str, float] = OrderedDict()
        self._max = max_entries

    def check_and_add(self, nonce: str, now: float) -> bool:
        cutoff = now - 2 * TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS
        while self._seen and (next(iter(self._seen.values())) < cutoff or len(self._seen) >= self._max):
            self._seen.popitem(last=False)
        if nonce in self._seen:
            return False
        self._seen[nonce] = now
        return True


def verify_request(secret: str, headers: dict[str, str], body: bytes, *, now: float | None = None, nonces: NonceStore | None = None) -> None:
    now = time.time() if now is None else now
    lowered = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}
    try:
        timestamp = int(lowered[HEADER_TIMESTAMP.lower()])
        nonce, signature = lowered[HEADER_NONCE.lower()], lowered[HEADER_SIGNATURE.lower()]
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        raise WebhookAuthError("missing_or_malformed_headers") from None
    if not nonce or len(nonce) > 200:
        raise WebhookAuthError("missing_or_malformed_headers")
    if abs(now - timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS:
        raise WebhookAuthError("timestamp_out_of_window")
    if not hmac.compare_digest(compute_signature(secret, timestamp, nonce, body), signature):
        raise WebhookAuthError("invalid_signature")
    if nonces is not None and not nonces.check_and_add(nonce, now):
        raise WebhookAuthError("replayed_request")

cat > app/outbox.py <<'EOF'
"""Transactional-outbox core: validated event registry, enqueue, sanitizing and dead-letter replay.

There is exactly ONE outbox (``outbox_events``). Every event type known to the system is declared in
``EVENT_SPECS`` with a strict payload model; anything else is rejected at enqueue time and dead-lettered by
the worker (never defaulted to a publication webhook).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import unicodedata
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, field_validator
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert as pg_insert
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import OutboxEvent, OutboxStatus
from app.settings import settings


class PermanentEventError(Exception):
    """The event can never succeed as-is (bad payload, rejected by provider...). Dead-letter immediately."""

    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str = "") -> None:
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code, self.message = code, message or code


class TransientEventError(Exception):
    """Retry later with backoff (optionally honouring a provider-supplied delay)."""

    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str = "", retry_after: float = 0.0) -> None:
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code, self.message, self.retry_after = code, message or code, retry_after


class UnknownEventType(PermanentEventError):
    def __init__(self, event_type: str) -> None:
        super().__init__("unknown_event_type", f"no handler is registered for {event_type[:80]!r}")


def _clean(value: str) -> str:
    return "".join(c for c in value if unicodedata.category(c) not in {"Cc", "Cf"} or c == "\u200c").strip()


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- payload models


class _Base(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID | None = None


class SocialPublishPayload(_Base):  # legacy n8n-dispatched events (payload shape unchanged)
    publication_id: uuid.UUID
    content_id: uuid.UUID
    platform: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=40)
    text: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50_000)
    idempotency_key: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=180)


class OutboundMessagePayload(_Base):
    outbound_message_id: uuid.UUID
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    customer_id: uuid.UUID
    channel: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=40)
    body: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50_000)
    idempotency_key: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=180)


class ProductPublishRequestedPayload(_Base):
    """Reference IDs only: the handler re-reads and re-authorizes everything from the database."""

    publication_id: uuid.UUID
    content_id: uuid.UUID
    content_version_id: uuid.UUID
    credential_id: uuid.UUID
    platform: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=40)
    idempotency_key: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=180)


class _ProductNotice(_Base):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    publication_id: uuid.UUID
    content_id: uuid.UUID
    content_version_id: uuid.UUID
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=180)

    @field_validator("title", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _title(cls, value):
        return _clean(value)[:180] if isinstance(value, str) else value


class ProductPublishedPayload(_ProductNotice):
    external_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    external_url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    @field_validator("external_url")
    @classmethod
    def _https_only(cls, value):
        if value is not None and not value.startswith("https://"):
            raise ValueError("external_url must be https")
        return value


class ProductPublishFailedPayload(_ProductNotice):
    error_code: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EventSpec:
    model: type[BaseModel]
    aggregate_type: str
    aggregate_field: str  # payload field that must equal the event's aggregate_id


EVENT_SPECS: dict[str, EventSpec] = {
    "content.publish.requested": EventSpec(SocialPublishPayload, "publication", "publication_id"),
    "message.outbound.requested": EventSpec(OutboundMessagePayload, "outbound_message", "outbound_message_id"),
    "product_content.publish.requested": EventSpec(ProductPublishRequestedPayload, "publication", "publication_id"),
    "product_content.published": EventSpec(ProductPublishedPayload, "publication", "publication_id"),
    "product_content.publish_failed": EventSpec(ProductPublishFailedPayload, "publication", "publication_id"),
}


def parse_payload(event_type: str, aggregate_type: str, aggregate_id: uuid.UUID, workspace_id: uuid.UUID, raw: dict | str) -> BaseModel:
    """Validate an event payload against its registered model and cross-check ownership/aggregate."""
    spec = EVENT_SPECS.get(event_type)
    if spec is None:
        raise UnknownEventType(event_type)
    try:
        model = spec.model.model_validate_json(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else spec.model.model_validate(raw)
    except (ValidationError, ValueError):
        raise PermanentEventError("invalid_payload", "payload does not match the event contract") from None
    if aggregate_type != spec.aggregate_type or getattr(model, spec.aggregate_field) != aggregate_id:
        raise PermanentEventError("invalid_payload", "payload does not match the event aggregate")
    if model.workspace_id is not None and model.workspace_id != workspace_id:
        raise PermanentEventError("invalid_payload", "payload workspace does not match the event owner")
    return model


async def enqueue_event(
    session: AsyncSession,
    *,
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID,
    event_type: str,
    aggregate_id: uuid.UUID,
    idempotency_key: str,
    payload: dict,
) -> bool:
    """Insert an event in the CALLER's transaction. Returns False if the idempotency key already exists.

    Nothing is committed here: the event becomes visible atomically with the business-state change.
    """
    spec = EVENT_SPECS.get(event_type)
    if spec is None:
        raise UnknownEventType(event_type)
    model = parse_payload(event_type, spec.aggregate_type, aggregate_id, workspace_id, {**payload, "workspace_id": str(workspace_id)})
    result = await session.execute(
        pg_insert(OutboxEvent)
        .values(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            event_type=event_type,
            aggregate_type=spec.aggregate_type,
            aggregate_id=aggregate_id,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key[:180],
            payload_json=json.dumps(model.model_dump(mode="json"), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
            status=OutboxStatus.pending,
            attempt_count=0,
        )
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(constraint="uq_outbox_workspace_idempotency")
        .returning(OutboxEvent.id)
    )
    return result.scalar_one_or_none() is not None


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- diagnostics


_REDACTIONS = (
    re.compile(r"bot\d{5,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)basic\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{8,}"),
    re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)\b(secret|token|password|passwd|authorization|api[_-]?key)\b\s*[:=]\s*\S+"),
)


def sanitize_error(text: object, limit: int = 500) -> str:
    """Bounded, secret-free diagnostic text safe to persist and show to workspace admins."""
    value = str(text)
    for secret in (settings.n8n_webhook_secret, settings.app_secret_key, settings.ai_api_key, settings.telegram_bot_token):
        if secret and len(secret) >= 8:
            value = value.replace(secret, "[redacted]")
    for pattern in _REDACTIONS:
        value = pattern.sub("[redacted]", value)
    value = "".join(c if c in "\n\t" or unicodedata.category(c) not in {"Cc", "Cf"} else " " for c in value)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()[:limit]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- dead-letter recovery


async def list_dead_letters(session: AsyncSession, workspace_id: uuid.UUID, limit: int = 100) -> list[OutboxEvent]:
    result = await session.execute(
        select(OutboxEvent)
        .where(OutboxEvent.workspace_id == workspace_id, OutboxEvent.status == OutboxStatus.dead_letter)
        .order_by(OutboxEvent.dead_lettered_at.desc())
        .limit(max(1, min(limit, 200)))
    )
    return list(result.scalars().all())


async def replay_dead_letter(session: AsyncSession, workspace_id: uuid.UUID, event_id: uuid.UUID) -> OutboxEvent:
    """Controlled replay: back to ``pending`` with a fresh retry budget. The same event id and idempotency key
    are kept, so handlers (which are idempotent) can safely process it again."""
    event = (
        await session.execute(
            select(OutboxEvent)
            .where(OutboxEvent.id == event_id, OutboxEvent.workspace_id == workspace_id)
            .with_for_update()
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if event is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Event not found in workspace")
    if event.status != OutboxStatus.dead_letter:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only dead-lettered events can be replayed")
    if event.event_type not in EVENT_SPECS:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Event type is not supported by this version")
    event.status = OutboxStatus.pending
    event.attempt_count = 0
    event.next_attempt_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    event.locked_at = event.locked_by = event.dead_lettered_at = None
    event.last_error = sanitize_error(f"replayed; previous failure: {event.last_error or 'unknown'}")
    await session.commit()
    await session.refresh(event)
    return event

cat > app/outbox_handlers.py <<'EOF'
"""Explicit event-handler registry for the outbox worker.

A handler returns normally ONLY when its required business action really succeeded; otherwise it raises
``TransientEventError`` (retry with backoff) or ``PermanentEventError`` (dead-letter now). Handlers never
trust n8n/event payloads for authorization: in-process handlers re-read and re-authorize from the database.

Delivery semantics: at-least-once. Telegram's sendMessage has no idempotency key, so when the outcome of a
send is ambiguous (n8n timeout/crash after Telegram accepted) a retry can produce a duplicate notification.
Every notification carries a short ``ref:`` (event id prefix) so a duplicate is recognisable. We do NOT claim
exactly-once delivery.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import uuid
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass

import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker

from app.domain import PublicationStatus
from app.hardening_domain import ProviderCredential, ProviderCredentialStatus
from app.outbox import (
    PermanentEventError,
    ProductPublishedPayload,
    ProductPublishFailedPayload,
    ProductPublishRequestedPayload,
    TransientEventError,
    UnknownEventType,
    canonical_event_body,
)
from app.settings import settings
from app.webhook_security import sign_headers
from app.wordpress_publication import ClientFactory, default_client_factory, publish_product_version

CHAT_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^(-?[0-9]{1,20}|@[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{4,31})$")
TRANSIENT_HTTP = frozenset({404, 408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504})  # 404 = workflow inactive/unregistered


@dataclass
class HandlerContext:
    event_id: uuid.UUID
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID
    event_type: str
    aggregate_type: str
    aggregate_id: uuid.UUID
    idempotency_key: str
    attempt: int
    payload: object  # validated pydantic model
    raw_payload: dict
    sf: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]
    http: httpx.AsyncClient
    wp_factory: ClientFactory = default_client_factory


Handler = Callable[[HandlerContext], Awaitable[None]]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- n8n transport


def _retry_after(headers: httpx.Headers, body: dict | None) -> float:
    for raw in (headers.get("retry-after"), (body or {}).get("retry_after")):
        try:
            if raw is not None:
                return min(900.0, max(0.0, float(raw)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
    return 0.0


def _json_or_none(response: httpx.Response) -> dict | None:
    try:
        data = response.json()
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


async def post_to_n8n(ctx: HandlerContext, url: str, document: dict, *, legacy_secret_header: bool, require_ok: bool) -> dict | None:
    """Signed POST to an n8n webhook. Success == 2xx (and ``{"ok": true}`` when required)."""
    body = canonical_event_body(document)
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", **sign_headers(settings.n8n_webhook_secret, f"{ctx.event_id}:{ctx.attempt}", body)}
    if legacy_secret_header:  # existing workflows authenticate with the shared secret header
        headers["X-Automation-Secret"] = settings.n8n_webhook_secret
    try:
        response = await ctx.http.post(url, content=body, headers=headers)
    except httpx.TimeoutException:
        raise TransientEventError("n8n_timeout", "n8n did not answer in time (outcome unknown)") from None
    except httpx.TransportError:
        raise TransientEventError("n8n_unreachable", "n8n could not be reached") from None
    parsed = _json_or_none(response)
    status = response.status_code
    if 200 <= status < 300:
        if require_ok and not (parsed and parsed.get("ok") is True):
            raise TransientEventError("n8n_unacknowledged", "n8n answered without an ok acknowledgement")
        return parsed
    code = str((parsed or {}).get("code", f"http_{status}"))[:60]
    if status in TRANSIENT_HTTP or status >= 500:
        raise TransientEventError(code, f"n8n/provider returned HTTP {status}", _retry_after(response.headers, parsed))
    raise PermanentEventError(code, f"n8n/provider rejected the event (HTTP {status})")


def webhook_for_event(event_type: str) -> str:
    urls = {
        "content.publish.requested": settings.n8n_publish_webhook_url,
        "message.outbound.requested": settings.n8n_outbound_webhook_url,
        "product_content.published": settings.n8n_notification_webhook_url,
        "product_content.publish_failed": settings.n8n_notification_webhook_url,
    }
    if event_type not in urls:
        raise UnknownEventType(event_type)  # never default an unknown event to the publish webhook
    return urls[event_type]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- handlers


async def handle_legacy_n8n(ctx: HandlerContext) -> None:
    """Social publish / outbound message: same envelope and secret-header contract as before."""
    envelope = {
        "event_id": str(ctx.event_id),
        "workspace_id": str(ctx.workspace_id),
        "event_type": ctx.event_type,
        "aggregate_type": ctx.aggregate_type,
        "aggregate_id": str(ctx.aggregate_id),
        "idempotency_key": ctx.idempotency_key,
        "payload": ctx.raw_payload,
    }
    await post_to_n8n(ctx, webhook_for_event(ctx.event_type), envelope, legacy_secret_header=True, require_ok=False)


async def handle_product_publish(ctx: HandlerContext) -> None:
    """Runs the Phase 4 WordPress publisher in-process (credentials never leave the application)."""
    payload: ProductPublishRequestedPayload = ctx.payload  # type: ignore[assignment]
    publication = await publish_product_version(
        ctx.sf, ctx.workspace_id, ctx.aggregate_id, client_factory=ctx.wp_factory
    )
    if publication.content_version_id != payload.content_version_id or publication.content_id != payload.content_id:
        raise PermanentEventError("payload_mismatch", "event does not match the stored publication")
    if publication.status == PublicationStatus.pending:  # transient failure or lease held elsewhere
        raise TransientEventError(publication.error_code or "publication_pending", "publication not finished yet")
    # published -> done; failed -> terminal business state already recorded (and a failure notice enqueued)


async def telegram_destination(sf: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession], workspace_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
    async with sf() as session:
        credential = (
            await session.execute(
                select(ProviderCredential)
                .where(
                    ProviderCredential.workspace_id == workspace_id,
                    ProviderCredential.provider == "telegram",
                    ProviderCredential.status == ProviderCredentialStatus.active,
                )
                .order_by(ProviderCredential.created_at.asc(), ProviderCredential.id.asc())
                .limit(1)
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
    chat_id = (credential.metadata_json or {}).get("chat_id") if credential else None
    if chat_id is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(chat_id, str) or not CHAT_ID_RE.match(chat_id):
        raise PermanentEventError("invalid_destination", "workspace telegram chat_id is invalid")
    return chat_id


def build_notice(ctx: HandlerContext) -> str:
    ref = f"ref:{str(ctx.event_id)[:8]}"
    if ctx.event_type == "product_content.published":
        p: ProductPublishedPayload = ctx.payload  # type: ignore[assignment]
        lines = ["✅ محصول منتشر شد", p.title] + ([p.external_url] if p.external_url else []) + [ref]
    else:
        p2: ProductPublishFailedPayload = ctx.payload  # type: ignore[assignment]
        lines = ["⚠️ انتشار محصول ناموفق بود", p2.title, f"code: {p2.error_code}", ref]
    return "\n".join(lines)[:3500]


async def handle_telegram_notice(ctx: HandlerContext) -> None:
    chat_id = await telegram_destination(ctx.sf, ctx.workspace_id)
    if chat_id is None:
        return  # no destination configured for this workspace: nothing to deliver (not an error)
    document = {
        "event_id": str(ctx.event_id),
        "workspace_id": str(ctx.workspace_id),
        "event_type": ctx.event_type,
        "attempt": ctx.attempt,
        "destination": {"chat_id": chat_id},
        "message": build_notice(ctx),
    }
    await post_to_n8n(ctx, webhook_for_event(ctx.event_type), document, legacy_secret_header=False, require_ok=True)


HANDLERS: dict[str, Handler] = {
    "content.publish.requested": handle_legacy_n8n,
    "message.outbound.requested": handle_legacy_n8n,
    "product_content.publish.requested": handle_product_publish,
    "product_content.published": handle_telegram_notice,
    "product_content.publish_failed": handle_telegram_notice,
}

cat > app/outbox_worker.py <<'EOF'
"""Outbox worker: claim one event at a time under a fenced, heartbeated lease; dispatch through the handler registry.

Safety properties
* One event is claimed at a time and its lease is renewed by a heartbeat while the handler runs, so queued
  events never "age out" behind a slow one and a slow handler is not mistaken for a crashed worker.
* Every state write is fenced by ``locked_by == this worker`` and ``status == processing``: a worker that lost
  its lease can never acknowledge or fail an event somebody else now owns.
* Reclaiming an expired lease counts as an attempt, so a poison event that kills workers ends in dead_letter.
* ``delivered`` is written only after the handler returned (its required action succeeded).
* Unknown event types / invalid payloads are dead-lettered immediately - never defaulted to a publication.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import httpx
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker

from app.database import SessionLocal
from app.domain import OutboxEvent, OutboxStatus
from app.outbox import PermanentEventError, TransientEventError, UnknownEventType, parse_payload, sanitize_error
from app.outbox_handlers import HANDLERS, HandlerContext, webhook_for_event  # noqa: F401 (re-exported)
from app.settings import settings
from app.wordpress_publication import ClientFactory, default_client_factory

logger = logging.getLogger("risheh.engage.outbox_worker")

WORKER_ID = f"{os.getenv('HOSTNAME', 'outbox-worker')}:{os.getpid()}:{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"[:120]
MAX_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS = 900


def backoff_seconds(attempt: int) -> int:
    return min(300, 2 ** max(1, attempt))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Claimed:
    id: uuid.UUID
    workspace_id: uuid.UUID
    event_type: str
    aggregate_type: str
    aggregate_id: uuid.UUID
    idempotency_key: str
    payload_json: str
    attempt: int  # 1-based number of THIS delivery attempt


SessionFactory = async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]


async def claim_one(sf: SessionFactory = SessionLocal, *, worker_id: str = WORKER_ID) -> Claimed | None:
    """Claim the oldest eligible event (pending, or processing with an expired lease)."""
    while True:
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        stale_before = now - timedelta(seconds=settings.outbox_lock_seconds)
        async with sf() as session:
            async with session.begin():
                event = (
                    await session.execute(
                        select(OutboxEvent)
                        .where(
                            OutboxEvent.status.in_([OutboxStatus.pending, OutboxStatus.processing]),
                            or_(OutboxEvent.next_attempt_at.is_(None), OutboxEvent.next_attempt_at <= now),
                            or_(OutboxEvent.locked_at.is_(None), OutboxEvent.locked_at < stale_before),
                        )
                        .order_by(OutboxEvent.created_at.asc())
                        .with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
                        .limit(1)
                    )
                ).scalar_one_or_none()
                if event is None:
                    return None
                if event.status == OutboxStatus.processing:  # lease expired: the previous owner died or stalled
                    event.attempt_count += 1
                    event.last_error = "lease expired before the event was acknowledged"
                    if event.attempt_count >= settings.outbox_max_attempts:
                        event.status, event.dead_lettered_at = OutboxStatus.dead_letter, now
                        event.locked_at = event.locked_by = event.next_attempt_at = None
                        continue
                event.status, event.locked_at, event.locked_by = OutboxStatus.processing, now, worker_id
                return Claimed(
                    event.id, event.workspace_id, event.event_type, event.aggregate_type, event.aggregate_id,
                    event.idempotency_key, event.payload_json, event.attempt_count + 1,
                )


async def _heartbeat(sf: SessionFactory, claimed: Claimed, worker_id: str, lost: asyncio.Event) -> None:
    interval = max(0.05, settings.outbox_lock_seconds / 3)
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(interval)
        async with sf() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                update(OutboxEvent)
                .where(OutboxEvent.id == claimed.id, OutboxEvent.locked_by == worker_id, OutboxEvent.status == OutboxStatus.processing)
                .values(locked_at=datetime.now(UTC))
            )
            await session.commit()
        if result.rowcount == 0:
            lost.set()
            return


async def _finish_delivered(sf: SessionFactory, claimed: Claimed, worker_id: str) -> bool:
    async with sf() as session:
        result = await session.execute(
            update(OutboxEvent)
            .where(OutboxEvent.id == claimed.id, OutboxEvent.locked_by == worker_id, OutboxEvent.status == OutboxStatus.processing)
            .values(status=OutboxStatus.delivered, locked_at=None, locked_by=None, last_error=None, next_attempt_at=None,
                    attempt_count=claimed.attempt)
        )
        await session.commit()
    return result.rowcount == 1


async def _finish_failure(sf: SessionFactory, claimed: Claimed, worker_id: str, error: str, *, permanent: bool, retry_after: float = 0.0) -> str | None:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    async with sf() as session:
        event = (
            await session.execute(
                select(OutboxEvent)
                .where(OutboxEvent.id == claimed.id, OutboxEvent.locked_by == worker_id, OutboxEvent.status == OutboxStatus.processing)
                .with_for_update()
                .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if event is None:
            return None  # lease lost: someone else owns this event now
        event.attempt_count = max(event.attempt_count, claimed.attempt)
        event.last_error = sanitize_error(error)
        event.locked_at = event.locked_by = None
        if permanent or event.attempt_count >= settings.outbox_max_attempts:
            event.status, event.dead_lettered_at, event.next_attempt_at = OutboxStatus.dead_letter, now, None
            outcome = "dead_letter"
        else:
            delay = min(MAX_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS, max(backoff_seconds(event.attempt_count), retry_after))
            event.status, event.next_attempt_at = OutboxStatus.pending, now + timedelta(seconds=delay)
            outcome = "retry"
        await session.commit()
        return outcome


async def process_claimed(
    sf: SessionFactory,
    claimed: Claimed,
    http: httpx.AsyncClient,
    *,
    worker_id: str = WORKER_ID,
    wp_factory: ClientFactory = default_client_factory,
) -> str:
    """Run the handler and record the outcome. Returns delivered | retry | dead_letter | lease_lost."""
    lost = asyncio.Event()
    heartbeat = asyncio.create_task(_heartbeat(sf, claimed, worker_id, lost))
    permanent, retry_after, error = False, 0.0, ""
    try:
        payload: BaseModel = parse_payload(
            claimed.event_type, claimed.aggregate_type, claimed.aggregate_id, claimed.workspace_id, claimed.payload_json
        )
        handler = HANDLERS.get(claimed.event_type)
        if handler is None:
            raise UnknownEventType(claimed.event_type)
        ctx = HandlerContext(
            event_id=claimed.id, workspace_id=claimed.workspace_id, event_type=claimed.event_type,
            aggregate_type=claimed.aggregate_type, aggregate_id=claimed.aggregate_id,
            idempotency_key=claimed.idempotency_key, attempt=claimed.attempt, payload=payload,
            raw_payload=json.loads(claimed.payload_json), sf=sf, http=http, wp_factory=wp_factory,
        )
        await handler(ctx)
        outcome_ok = True
    except PermanentEventError as exc:
        outcome_ok, permanent, error = False, True, f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}"
    except TransientEventError as exc:
        outcome_ok, retry_after, error = False, exc.retry_after, f"{exc.code}: {exc.message}"
    except Exception as exc:  # unexpected: bounded retries, type only (messages may carry untrusted data)
        outcome_ok, error = False, f"internal_error: {type(exc).__name__}"
        logger.error("outbox handler crashed type=%s event=%s", type(exc).__name__, claimed.id)
    finally:
        heartbeat.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(heartbeat, return_exceptions=True)

    if lost.is_set():
        logger.warning("outbox lease lost event=%s; not recording an outcome", claimed.id)
        return "lease_lost"
    if outcome_ok:
        return "delivered" if await _finish_delivered(sf, claimed, worker_id) else "lease_lost"
    result = await _finish_failure(sf, claimed, worker_id, error, permanent=permanent, retry_after=retry_after)
    return result or "lease_lost"


def _http_client() -> httpx.AsyncClient:
    return httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5.0, read=30.0, write=10.0, pool=5.0), follow_redirects=False)


async def run_once(
    sf: SessionFactory = SessionLocal,
    *,
    http: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    worker_id: str = WORKER_ID,
    wp_factory: ClientFactory = default_client_factory,
    limit: int | None = None,
) -> int:
    owns_client = http is None
    http = http or _http_client()
    processed = 0
    try:
        for _ in range(limit or settings.outbox_batch_size):
            claimed = await claim_one(sf, worker_id=worker_id)
            if claimed is None:
                break
            outcome = await process_claimed(sf, claimed, http, worker_id=worker_id, wp_factory=wp_factory)
            logger.info("outbox event=%s type=%s attempt=%d outcome=%s", claimed.id, claimed.event_type, claimed.attempt, outcome)
            processed += 1
    finally:
        if owns_client:
            await http.aclose()
    return processed


async def main() -> None:
    async with _http_client() as http:
        while True:
            try:
                processed = await run_once(http=http)
            except Exception as exc:  # DB blips must not kill the worker; leases recover anything in flight
                logger.error("outbox loop error type=%s", type(exc).__name__)
                processed = 0
            if processed == 0:
                await asyncio.sleep(settings.outbox_poll_seconds)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
EOF

from datetime import datetime

from app.outbox import list_dead_letters, replay_dead_letter

):

    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),
):

class FakeN8N:
    def __init__(self):
        self.requests, self.queue, self.delay, self.on_request = [], [], 0.0, None

    def respond(self, *items):
        self.queue.extend(items)

    async def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        self.requests.append({"path": request.url.path, "headers": dict(request.headers), "raw": request.content, "body": body})
        if self.on_request:
            await self.on_request(body)
        if self.delay:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
        item = self.queue.pop(0) if self.queue else (200, {"ok": True})
        if isinstance(item, Exception):
            raise item
        status, payload, *extra = item
        return httpx.Response(status, json=payload, headers=extra[0] if extra else None)

    def http(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(self.handler))

# ============================================================================ pure: signing, registry, sanitizer


SECRET = "s" * 40


def test_signature_roundtrip_tamper_wrong_secret_and_missing_headers():
    body = ws.canonical_body({"b": 1, "a": "سلام", "n": {"z": [1, 2], "y": None}})
    assert body == '{"a":"سلام","b":1,"n":{"y":null,"z":[1,2]}}'.encode()
    now = time.time()
    headers = ws.sign_headers(SECRET, "evt:1", body, now=now)
    ws.verify_request(SECRET, headers, body, now=now)
    for bad_body, bad_secret in ((body + b" ", SECRET), (body, "t" * 40)):
        with pytest.raises(ws.WebhookAuthError) as exc:
            ws.verify_request(bad_secret, headers, bad_body, now=now)
        assert exc.value.reason == "invalid_signature"
    for drop in ws.HEADER_TIMESTAMP, ws.HEADER_NONCE, ws.HEADER_SIGNATURE:
        with pytest.raises(ws.WebhookAuthError) as exc:
            ws.verify_request(SECRET, {k: v for k, v in headers.items() if k != drop}, body, now=now)
        assert exc.value.reason == "missing_or_malformed_headers"
    forged = {**headers, ws.HEADER_NONCE: "evt:2"}  # signature is bound to the nonce
    with pytest.raises(ws.WebhookAuthError):
        ws.verify_request(SECRET, forged, body, now=now)


def test_timestamp_window_and_replay_protection():
    body, now = b"{}", 1_700_000_000.0
    store = ws.NonceStore()
    headers = ws.sign_headers(SECRET, "n-1", body, now=now)
    ws.verify_request(SECRET, headers, body, now=now + 10, nonces=store)
    with pytest.raises(ws.WebhookAuthError) as exc:
        ws.verify_request(SECRET, headers, body, now=now + 20, nonces=store)
    assert exc.value.reason == "replayed_request"
    ws.verify_request(SECRET, ws.sign_headers(SECRET, "n-2", body, now=now), body, now=now, nonces=store)  # fresh nonce ok
    for skew in (ws.TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS + 5, -(ws.TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_SECONDS + 5)):
        with pytest.raises(ws.WebhookAuthError) as exc:
            ws.verify_request(SECRET, ws.sign_headers(SECRET, "n-3", body, now=now), body, now=now + skew)
        assert exc.value.reason == "timestamp_out_of_window"
    small = ws.NonceStore(max_entries=3)
    for i in range(10):
        assert small.check_and_add(f"x{i}", now)  # bounded memory

    assert set(ob.EVENT_SPECS) == set(oh.HANDLERS)
    with pytest.raises(ob.UnknownEventType):
        oh.webhook_for_event("something.new.requested")
    assert oh.webhook_for_event("content.publish.requested") == settings.n8n_publish_webhook_url
    assert oh.webhook_for_event("message.outbound.requested") == settings.n8n_outbound_webhook_url
    assert oh.webhook_for_event("product_content.published") == settings.n8n_notification_webhook_url


def test_payload_contracts():
    wsid, pid = uuid.uuid4(), uuid.uuid4()

    model = ob.parse_payload("product_content.published", "publication", pid, wsid, good)
    assert model.title == "لیوان سرامیکی"
    cases = [
        ({**good, "extra": 1}, pid, wsid),  # forbid extras on notices
        ({**good, "external_url": "http://plain.example.com"}, pid, wsid),
        ({**good, "title": ""}, pid, wsid), ({**good, "external_id": ""}, pid, wsid),

        (good, pid, uuid.uuid4()),  # workspace mismatch
        ({k: v for k, v in good.items() if k != "publication_id"}, pid, wsid),

def test_sanitizer_redacts_secrets_and_bounds_output(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "n8n_webhook_secret", "hook-secret-value-123456")
    raw = ("POST https://api.telegram.org/bot123456789:AAHabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456/sendMessage failed "

    pid, key = uuid.uuid4(), "outbox:same-key"
    payload = notice_payload(pid)
    async with sf() as s:  # rolled back with the business change -> no event
        assert await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=a.workspace_id, event_type="product_content.published", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key=key, payload=payload)
        await s.rollback()
    async with sf() as s:
        assert (await s.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(OutboxEvent).where(OutboxEvent.workspace_id == a.workspace_id))).scalar_one() == 0
    async with sf() as s:
        first = await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=a.workspace_id, event_type="product_content.published", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key=key, payload=payload)
        again = await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=a.workspace_id, event_type="product_content.published", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key=key, payload=payload)
        await s.commit()
    assert (first, again) == (True, False)
    async with sf() as s:  # the same key in another workspace is an unrelated event
        assert await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=b.workspace_id, event_type="product_content.published", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key=key, payload=payload)
        await s.commit()
        rows = (await s.execute(select(OutboxEvent).where(OutboxEvent.idempotency_key == key))).scalars().all()
    assert {r.workspace_id for r in rows} == {a.workspace_id, b.workspace_id}
    stored = json.loads(rows[0].payload_json)
    assert stored["workspace_id"] == str(rows[0].workspace_id) and rows[0].status == OutboxStatus.pending
    async with sf() as s:
        with pytest.raises(ob.UnknownEventType):
            await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=a.workspace_id, event_type="bogus.event", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key="k-2", payload={})
        with pytest.raises(ob.PermanentEventError):
            await ob.enqueue_event(s, workspace_id=a.workspace_id, event_type="product_content.published", aggregate_id=pid, idempotency_key="k-3", payload={"title": "x"})

async def test_expired_lease_is_recovered_and_counts_as_an_attempt(sf, monkeypatch):
    w, n8n = await make_world(sf), FakeN8N()
    event_id = await social_event(sf, w)
    async with sf() as s:  # a worker claimed it and died
        await s.execute(text("UPDATE outbox_events SET status='processing', locked_by='dead-worker', locked_at = now() - interval '1 hour' WHERE id=:i"), {"i": event_id})
        await s.commit()
    assert await work(sf, n8n, worker_id="alive") == 1
    row = await event_row(sf, event_id)
    assert row.status == OutboxStatus.delivered and row.attempt_count == 2  # 1 (crashed attempt) + 1 (this one)

    poison = await social_event(sf, w)
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "outbox_max_attempts", 3)
    async with sf() as s:  # keeps killing workers: stale lease at the attempt limit -> dead-letter, handler never re-run
        await s.execute(text("UPDATE outbox_events SET status='processing', attempt_count=2, locked_by='dead', locked_at = now() - interval '1 hour' WHERE id=:i"), {"i": poison})
        await s.commit()
    calls = len(n8n.requests)
    await work(sf, n8n)
    row = await event_row(sf, poison)
    assert row.status == OutboxStatus.dead_letter and "lease expired" in row.last_error and len(n8n.requests) == calls

async def test_wordpress_transient_failure_retries_through_the_worker_without_duplicates(sf):
    w, n8n, fake = await make_world(sf), FakeN8N(), FakeWP()
    _, _, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    from app import wordpress_publication as wpp
    fake.post_modes = ["timeout_after_create"] + ["503"] * 2  # created remotely, response lost, then WordPress flaps
    fake.lookup_failures = 0
    async with sf() as s:
        (event_id,) = (await s.execute(select(OutboxEvent.id).where(OutboxEvent.workspace_id == w.workspace_id))).scalars().all()
    orig_sleep = wpp.asyncio.sleep

    async def fast(_):
        return None

    wpp.asyncio.sleep = fast
    try:
        await work(sf, n8n, wp=fake, limit=1)
        row = await event_row(sf, event_id)
        if row.status != OutboxStatus.delivered:  # not finished in one go -> retried later by the worker
            assert row.status == OutboxStatus.pending and row.next_attempt_at is not None
            await make_due(sf, event_id)
            await work(sf, n8n, wp=fake, limit=1)
    finally:
        wpp.asyncio.sleep = orig_sleep
    async with sf() as s:
        pub = await s.get(Publication, pid)
    assert (await event_row(sf, event_id)).status == OutboxStatus.delivered
    assert pub.status == PublicationStatus.published and len(fake.posts) == 1  # one remote post despite the retries

# ============================================================================ the n8n workflow itself (executed with node)


def _workflow():
    return json.loads(WORKFLOW.read_text())


def test_workflow_file_is_well_formed_and_secret_free():
    wf = _workflow()
    names = {n["name"] for n in wf["nodes"]}
    for source, outputs in wf["connections"].items():
        assert source in names
        for branch in outputs["main"]:
            for link in branch:
                assert link["node"] in names
    raw = WORKFLOW.read_text()
    assert wf["name"] == "ENGAGE__NOTIFY__TELEGRAM__V1" and wf["active"] is False
    assert "$env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" in raw and "$env.RISHEH_AUTOMATION_SECRET" in raw
    import re
    assert not re.search(r"\d{6,}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", raw)  # no literal bot token
    send = next(n for n in wf["nodes"] if n["name"] == "Telegram Send Message")["parameters"]["options"]
    assert send["timeout"] <= 15000 and send["response"]["response"]["neverError"] is True  # error text (with token URL) never escapes


needs_node = pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("node") is None, reason="node is required to execute the n8n Code nodes")
HARNESS = r"""
const input = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'));
const store = {};
const run = (code, json, env) => new Function('$json', '$env', '$getWorkflowStaticData', 'require', `return (async () => {${code}})()`)(json, env, () => store, require);
(async () => { const out = []; for (const c of input.cases) out.push(await run(input.code, c.json, c.env || {})); console.log(JSON.stringify(out)); })();
"""


def run_node(node_name, cases):
    code = next(n for n in _workflow()["nodes"] if n["name"] == node_name)["parameters"]["jsCode"]
    result = subprocess.run(["node", "-e", HARNESS], input=json.dumps({"code": code, "cases": cases}), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    return json.loads(result.stdout)


def signed_request(envelope, *, secret=SECRET, nonce=None, now=None, tamper=None):
    body = ws.canonical_body(envelope)
    headers = ws.sign_headers(secret, nonce or f"{envelope['event_id']}:{envelope['attempt']}", body, now=now)
    sent = dict(envelope)
    if tamper:
        sent.update(tamper)
    return {"headers": {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}, "body": sent}


def envelope(**over):
    base = {"event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "workspace_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "event_type": "product_content.published", "attempt": 1,
            "destination": {"chat_id": "-100123"}, "message": "✅ محصول منتشر شد\nلیوان «سرامیکی» 😀\nhttps://blog.example.com/p/\nref:abcd1234"}
    return {**base, **over}


@needs_node
def test_n8n_node_accepts_valid_signed_requests_and_matches_the_python_signer():
    env = {"RISHEH_AUTOMATION_SECRET": SECRET}
    e = envelope()
    out = run_node("Verify Signature & Validate", [{"json": signed_request(e), "env": env}])[0]
    assert out[0]["json"] == {"ok": True, "event_id": e["event_id"], "chat_id": "-100123", "text": e["message"]}


@needs_node
def test_n8n_node_rejects_bad_signatures_stale_timestamps_replays_and_bad_payloads():
    env = {"RISHEH_AUTOMATION_SECRET": SECRET}
    now = time.time()
    good = envelope()
    replay_nonce = "evt-replay:1"
    cases = [
        ({"json": signed_request(good, now=now), "env": env}, 200 and None),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), secret="x" * 40), "env": env}, (401, "invalid_signature")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), tamper={"message": "tampered"}), "env": env}, (401, "invalid_signature")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), now=now - 4000), "env": env}, (401, "timestamp_out_of_window")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), now=now + 4000), "env": env}, (401, "timestamp_out_of_window")),
        ({"json": {"headers": {}, "body": envelope()}, "env": env}, (401, "invalid_signature")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope()), "env": {}}, (401, "invalid_signature")),  # secret not configured: fail closed
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), nonce=replay_nonce), "env": env}, None),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(), nonce=replay_nonce), "env": env}, (409, "replayed_request")),  # same nonce again
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(event_type="content.publish.requested")), "env": env}, (422, "unsupported_event")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(destination={"chat_id": "12; drop"})), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_destination")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(destination={})), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_destination")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(message="")), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_message")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(message="x" * 4001)), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_message")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(message="bad\x07char")), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_message")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(attempt=0)), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_payload")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(event_id="not-a-uuid")), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_payload")),
        ({"json": signed_request(envelope(extra="x")), "env": env}, (422, "invalid_payload")),
        ({"json": {"headers": {}, "body": [1]}, "env": env}, (400, "invalid_body")),
    ]
    results = run_node("Verify Signature & Validate", [c for c, _ in cases])
    for (case, expected), result in zip(cases, results):
        item = result[0]["json"]
        if expected is None:
            assert item["ok"] is True, case
        else:
            assert (item["http_status"], item["body"]["code"]) == expected, case
            assert item["ok"] is False


@needs_node
@pytest.mark.parametrize("status,body,expected", [
    (200, {"ok": True, "result": {"message_id": 77}}, (200, {"ok": True, "telegram_message_id": "77"})),
    (429, {"parameters": {"retry_after": 17}}, (429, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_rate_limited", "retry_after": 17})),
    (429, {}, (429, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_rate_limited", "retry_after": 30})),
    (500, {}, (502, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_unavailable"})),
    (401, {}, (422, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_unauthorized"})),
    (403, {"description": "bot was blocked"}, (422, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_rejected"})),
    (400, {}, (422, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_rejected"})),
    (302, {}, (502, {"ok": False, "code": "telegram_unexpected_response"})),
])
def test_n8n_node_classifies_telegram_responses_without_leaking_upstream_text(status, body, expected):
    (result,) = run_node("Classify Telegram Response", [{"json": {"statusCode": status, "body": body}}])
    out = result[0]["json"]
    assert (out["http_status"], out["body"]) == expected
    assert "blocked" not in json.dumps(out)
