# ============================================================================ dead-letter recovery (API)


from tests.test_wordpress_publication import api_client  # noqa: E402


async def viewer_header(sf, w):
    async with sf() as s:
        viewer = User(email=f"v-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com", password_hash="x", full_name="V")
        s.add(viewer)
        await s.flush()
        s.add(Membership(workspace_id=w.workspace_id, user_id=viewer.id, role=WorkspaceRole.viewer))
        await s.commit()
        return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {create_access_token(viewer)}"}


@db
async def test_dead_letters_are_listed_sanitized_and_workspace_scoped(sf):
    w, other, n8n = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf), FakeN8N()
    event_id = await social_event(sf, w)
    n8n.respond((401, {"code": "invalid_signature", "detail": "Bearer abc.def.ghi"}))
    await work(sf, n8n)
    base = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/outbox"
    async with api_client(sf, outbox_router) as c:
        assert (await c.get(f"{base}/dead-letters")).status_code == 401
        assert (await c.get(f"{base}/dead-letters", headers=await viewer_header(sf, w))).status_code == 403
        assert (await c.get(f"{base}/dead-letters", headers=await hdr(sf, other))).status_code == 403
        listing = await c.get(f"{base}/dead-letters", headers=await hdr(sf, w))
        empty = await c.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{other.workspace_id}/outbox/dead-letters", headers=await hdr(sf, other))
    (item,) = listing.json()
    assert item["id"] == str(event_id) and item["event_type"] == "content.publish.requested" and item["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert "payload" not in item and "abc.def.ghi" not in listing.text and item["last_error"].startswith("invalid_signature")
    assert empty.json() == []


@db
async def test_dead_letter_replay_recovers_the_event_with_a_fresh_budget(sf):
    w, other, n8n = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf), FakeN8N()
    event_id = await social_event(sf, w)
    n8n.respond((401, {"code": "invalid_signature"}))
    await work(sf, n8n)
    assert (await event_row(sf, event_id)).status == OutboxStatus.dead_letter
    url = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/outbox/{event_id}/replay"
    async with api_client(sf, outbox_router) as c:
        assert (await c.post(url)).status_code == 401
        assert (await c.post(url, headers=await viewer_header(sf, w))).status_code == 403
        cross = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{other.workspace_id}/outbox/{event_id}/replay"
        assert (await c.post(cross, headers=await hdr(sf, other))).status_code == 404  # not visible cross-tenant
        assert (await c.post(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/outbox/{uuid.uuid4()}/replay", headers=await hdr(sf, w))).status_code == 404
        replay = await c.post(url, headers=await hdr(sf, w))
        again = await c.post(url, headers=await hdr(sf, w))  # no longer dead-lettered
    assert replay.status_code == 200 and again.status_code == 409
    row = await event_row(sf, event_id)
    assert row.status == OutboxStatus.pending and row.attempt_count == 0 and row.dead_lettered_at is None and "replayed" in row.last_error
    n8n.respond((200, {"accepted": True}))  # the operator fixed the n8n secret
    await work(sf, n8n)
    row = await event_row(sf, event_id)
    assert row.status == OutboxStatus.delivered and row.attempt_count == 1
    assert [r["body"]["event_id"] for r in n8n.requests] == [str(event_id)] * 2  # same event id: handlers dedupe on it

        cid = content.json()["id"]

        assert (await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/approve", headers=h, json={"note": "ok"})).status_code == 200
        r = await c.post(f"{base}/contents/{cid}/publish", headers=h, json={"idempotency_key": "social-publish-1"})
        assert r.status_code == 200
    async with sf() as s:
        (event,) = (await s.execute(select(OutboxEvent).where(OutboxEvent.workspace_id == w.workspace_id))).scalars().all()
    assert event.event_type == "content.publish.requested" and event.idempotency_key == "outbox:social-publish-1"
    assert json.loads(event.payload_json)["text"] == "متن پست"  # the legacy payload is unchanged
    assert await work(sf, n8n) == 1
    assert (await event_row(sf, event.id)).status == OutboxStatus.delivered
    assert n8n.requests[0]["path"] == "/webhook/risheh-engage-publish"
    assert n8n.requests[0]["body"]["payload"]["publication_id"] == r.json()["id"]

## Phase 5 — Outbox، Worker، n8n و Telegram (پیاده‌سازی‌شده)
- **یک outbox** (`outbox_events`) با رجیستری صریح `outbox.EVENT_SPECS` (payload مدل‌دار) و `outbox_handlers.HANDLERS`. رویداد ناشناخته/payload نامعتبر/ناهمخوان با workspace یا aggregate ⇒ بلافاصله `dead_letter` (هرگز به webhook انتشار فرستاده نمی‌شود). رویدادهای محصول با `enqueue_event` در **همان تراکنش** تغییر وضعیت ساخته می‌شوند (کلید یکتا `(workspace, key)`؛ `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`): `product_content.publish.requested` (فقط IDها)، `product_content.published`، `product_content.publish_failed`.
- **Worker**: claim تکی با `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`، heartbeat برای تمدید lease، تمام نوشتن‌ها با fence (`locked_by` + `status=processing`)، بازیابی lease منقضی‌شده = یک تلاش (poison ⇒ DLQ)، `delivered` فقط بعد از موفقیت handler، backoff نمایی (+ `Retry-After`/`retry_after`)، خطای دائمی (4xx جز 404/408/425/429) ⇒ DLQ فوری. `last_error` همیشه sanitize می‌شود.
- **انتشار WordPress** داخل worker (in-process) اجرا می‌شود؛ publication pending ⇒ retry توسط worker، failed ⇒ حالت نهایی کسب‌وکار (رویداد `publish_failed` + اعلان).
- **n8n**: workflow جدید `automation/workflows/telegram_notify_v1.json` (`ENGAGE__NOTIFY__TELEGRAM__V1`)؛ درخواست با HMAC (`X-Engage-Timestamp/Nonce/Signature`، پنجره ±300s، nonce تکراری ⇒ 409) امضا می‌شود و secret مشترک ارسال نمی‌شود. workflowهای قبلی همچنان با `X-Automation-Secret` کار می‌کنند (امضا هم اضافه است). توکن bot فقط در env سرویس n8n است؛ مقصد (`chat_id`) از credential `telegram` همان workspace (`metadata.chat_id`) می‌آید؛ بدون مقصد ⇒ اعلان رد می‌شود (خطا نیست).
- **DLQ**: `GET /workspaces/{ws}/outbox/dead-letters` و `POST /workspaces/{ws}/outbox/{id}/replay` (owner/admin؛ بدون payload در پاسخ).
- **تنظیمات لازم** (در checkout فعلی فایل‌های compose/.env نبود؛ دستی اضافه کنید): `N8N_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL=http://n8n:5678/webhook/risheh-engage-notify` برای worker/API و برای n8n: `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` (تأیید امضا)، `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`، `RISHEH_AUTOMATION_SECRET` (= `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET`).
- **محدودیت (Telegram)**: `sendMessage` ایدمپوتنسی ندارد؛ تحویل **at-least-once** است. اگر نتیجه مبهم باشد (timeout/crash بعد از پذیرش Telegram) retry ممکن است اعلان تکراری بسازد؛ هر پیام `ref:<event id>` دارد. exactly-once ادعا نمی‌شود. nonce replay-cache در n8n در static data است (با restart پاک می‌شود؛ پنجره‌ی زمانی همچنان برقرار است).
EOF

# Phase 6 — Product Content Web UI

Implement only Phase 6.

IMPORTANT:
- Optimize for context/token efficiency.
- Do NOT rescan the repository.
- Do NOT re-audit Phases 0–5.
- Inspect only the existing frontend structure and the backend API contracts directly required by this phase.
- Verify previous-phase contracts only where the UI depends on them.
- Do not repeat previous findings.
- Do not inspect unchanged files without a concrete dependency.
- Do not start Phase 7.

## Scope

Extend the existing frontend for the Product Content workflow.

The UI must allow users to understand and operate the existing backend workflow without creating a parallel business logic layer.

Implement only what the current backend contracts support.

## 1. Product Content Jobs

Add the minimum UI needed to:

- list Product Content Jobs
- view job details
- show product/snapshot information
- show current lifecycle state
- show current ContentVersion
- show revision count/limit
- show validation status
- show quality status
- show review/approval status
- show publication status
- show relevant sanitized errors

Respect workspace boundaries enforced by the backend.

Do not implement client-side authorization as a substitute for backend authorization.

## 2. Content Versions

Provide a clear version/history view.

Show:

- version number
- source
- model/provider metadata where appropriate
- creation time
- validation result
- quality result
- revision relationship

Versions must be displayed as immutable history.

Do not allow the UI to mutate an existing ContentVersion.

## 3. Human Review

Add the minimum review interface required by the existing approval API.

Allow an authorized authenticated user to:

- inspect the exact version
- review validation/quality results
- approve or reject according to the existing backend contract

Do not allow the client to select or spoof the reviewer identity.

Do not duplicate approval/business rules in frontend code.

## 4. Publication Status

Display publication state clearly, including where available:

- pending
- in progress
- published
- failed
- retryable/attention state
- external WordPress ID/URL

Do not implement WordPress API calls in the frontend.

Do not let the frontend bypass publication authorization.

## 5. Persian / RTL

The Product Content UI must support:

- Persian text
- RTL layout
- correct mixed Persian/English rendering
- readable long content
- correct display of URLs, IDs, timestamps, and technical values
- Unicode-safe forms and content rendering

Reuse the existing frontend design system and patterns.

Do not introduce a second UI framework or unnecessary component library.

## 6. API Client & State

Reuse the existing API client/authentication/data-fetching patterns.

Do not create duplicate request/authentication implementations.

Handle:

- loading
- empty states
- validation errors
- authorization errors
- network failures
- server errors
- retryable states

Do not expose secrets or sensitive backend data.

## 7. Security

Treat all backend content as untrusted.

Prevent unsafe HTML/script execution when displaying generated or external content.

Do not rely on frontend checks for:

- authorization
- workspace isolation
- approval
- publication permission

The backend remains authoritative.

## 8. Tests

Add focused Phase 6 tests only where the existing frontend test architecture supports them:

- job list/detail rendering
- version history
- state/status rendering
- approval flow
- error states
- workspace/API boundary behavior
- Persian/RTL rendering where practical
- unsafe content rendering/XSS protection

Preserve existing frontend tests.

Do not implement Phase 7+ tests.

## Restrictions

Do NOT implement:

- new backend business logic unless a clearly missing API contract blocks the UI
- WooCommerce logic
- AI logic
- WordPress client logic
- n8n/Telegram changes
- security hardening unrelated to the UI
- full E2E suite
- unrelated refactors

If an existing backend contract is genuinely insufficient for the required UI, make the smallest compatible change necessary and do not redesign the backend.

Do not start Phase 7.

## Completion

Before finishing:

1. Run focused frontend tests.
2. Run relevant existing regression tests.
3. Verify Persian/RTL rendering.
4. Verify unsafe content is safely rendered.
5. Verify UI does not bypass backend authorization.
6. Verify no future-phase functionality was added.

Keep the final response minimal.

Do not provide a long report.
Do not repeat previous findings.
Do not summarize unchanged architecture.

After successful completion, respond exactly:

Phase 6 complete.

If genuinely blocked:

Phase 6 complete — blocker: <short concrete description>.

STOP.

"""Read-only views for the Product Content UI (list + detail). No business logic: state comes from the database.

Everything returned is already sanitized server-side text/IDs; the UI still treats it as untrusted.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.auth import require_workspace_member
from app.database import get_session
from app.domain import Approval, ContentItem, ContentVersion, Membership, Publication, PublicationStatus
from app.outbox import sanitize_error
from app.product_domain import ProductContentJob, ProductSnapshot

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["product-content-views"])
LIST_LIMIT = 100


class IssueView(BaseModel):
    code: str = ""
    severity: str | None = None
    field: str = ""
    message: str = ""


class ValidationView(BaseModel):
    passed: bool
    validator_version: str | None = None
    issues: list[IssueView] = []


class QualityView(BaseModel):
    acceptable: bool
    score: int | None = None
    verdict: str | None = None
    model: str | None = None
    provider: str | None = None
    prompt_version: str | None = None
    issues: list[IssueView] = []


class ContentPayloadView(BaseModel):
    title: str = ""
    excerpt: str = ""
    body: str = ""
    meta_description: str = ""


class VersionView(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    version_no: int
    source: str
    model: str | None
    prompt_version: str | None
    content_hash: str
    created_at: datetime
    is_current: bool
    revises_version_no: int | None
    payload: ContentPayloadView
    validation: ValidationView | None
    quality: QualityView | None


class ApprovalView(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    decision: str
    content_version_id: uuid.UUID | None
    approver_user_id: uuid.UUID | None
    reviewer_name: str
    note: str
    created_at: datetime


class PublicationView(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    status: str
    content_version_id: uuid.UUID | None
    credential_id: uuid.UUID | None
    attempt_count: int
    in_progress: bool
    retryable: bool
    needs_attention: bool
    error_code: str | None
    error_message: str | None
    external_id: str | None
    external_url: str | None
    last_attempt_at: datetime | None
    created_at: datetime


class SnapshotView(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    external_product_id: str
    fetched_at: datetime
    source_hash: str
    name: str = ""
    sku: str = ""
    price: str | None = None
    regular_price: str | None = None
    sale_price: str | None = None
    stock_status: str | None = None
    categories: list[str] = []


class JobSummary(BaseModel):
    job_id: uuid.UUID
    content_id: uuid.UUID
    status: str
    product_name: str
    external_product_id: str
    revision_count: int
    max_revisions: int
    attempts: int
    error_code: str | None
    content_status: str
    current_version_no: int | None
    validation_passed: bool | None
    quality_acceptable: bool | None
    publication_status: str | None
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime


class JobDetail(JobSummary):
    last_error: str | None
    current_version_id: uuid.UUID | None
    snapshot: SnapshotView
    versions: list[VersionView]
    approvals: list[ApprovalView]
    publications: list[PublicationView]


def _issues(report: dict) -> list[IssueView]:
    raw = report.get("issues")
    out = []
    for item in (raw if isinstance(raw, list) else [])[:50]:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            out.append(IssueView(code=str(item.get("code", ""))[:60], severity=str(item["severity"])[:20] if item.get("severity") else None,
                                 field=str(item.get("field", ""))[:60], message=str(item.get("message", ""))[:300]))
    return out


def _validation(report: dict | None) -> ValidationView | None:
    if not isinstance(report, dict):
        return None
    return ValidationView(passed=report.get("passed") is True, validator_version=report.get("validator_version"), issues=_issues(report))


def _quality(report: dict | None) -> QualityView | None:
    if not isinstance(report, dict):
        return None
    score = report.get("score")
    return QualityView(
        acceptable=report.get("acceptable") is True, score=score if isinstance(score, int) and not isinstance(score, bool) else None,
        verdict=report.get("verdict") if isinstance(report.get("verdict"), str) else None,
        model=report.get("model"), provider=report.get("provider"), prompt_version=report.get("prompt_version"), issues=_issues(report),
    )


def _payload(raw: object) -> ContentPayloadView:
    data = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    return ContentPayloadView(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in ContentPayloadView.model_fields and isinstance(v, str)})


def _publication(p: Publication, now: datetime) -> PublicationView:
    pending = p.status == PublicationStatus.pending
    return PublicationView(
        id=p.id, status=p.status.value, content_version_id=p.content_version_id, credential_id=p.credential_id,
        attempt_count=p.attempt_count, in_progress=pending and p.lease_expires_at is not None and p.lease_expires_at > now,
        retryable=pending and p.error_code is not None, needs_attention=p.status == PublicationStatus.failed,
        error_code=p.error_code, error_message=sanitize_error(p.error_message) if p.error_message else None,
        external_id=p.external_id, external_url=p.external_url, last_attempt_at=p.last_attempt_at, created_at=p.created_at,
    )


async def _context(session: AsyncSession, workspace_id: uuid.UUID, jobs: list[ProductContentJob]):
    if not jobs:
        return {}, {}, {}, {}
    snapshots = {s.id: s for s in (await session.execute(select(ProductSnapshot).where(
        ProductSnapshot.workspace_id == workspace_id, ProductSnapshot.id.in_({j.snapshot_id for j in jobs})))).scalars()}
    contents = {c.id: c for c in (await session.execute(select(ContentItem).where(
        ContentItem.workspace_id == workspace_id, ContentItem.id.in_({j.content_id for j in jobs})))).scalars()}
    version_ids = {c.current_version_id for c in contents.values() if c.current_version_id}
    versions = {v.id: v for v in (await session.execute(select(ContentVersion).where(
        ContentVersion.workspace_id == workspace_id, ContentVersion.id.in_(version_ids)))).scalars()} if version_ids else {}
    latest: dict[uuid.UUID, Publication] = {}
    for p in (await session.execute(select(Publication).where(
            Publication.workspace_id == workspace_id, Publication.content_id.in_(set(contents))).order_by(Publication.created_at.desc()))).scalars():
        latest.setdefault(p.content_id, p)
    return snapshots, contents, versions, latest


def _summary(job, snapshots, contents, versions, latest) -> JobSummary:
    snap, content = snapshots[job.snapshot_id], contents[job.content_id]
    version = versions.get(content.current_version_id) if content.current_version_id else None
    name = snap.data.get("name") if isinstance(snap.data, dict) else None
    validation, quality = _validation(version.validation_report if version else None), _quality(version.quality_report if version else None)
    return JobSummary(
        job_id=job.id, content_id=job.content_id, status=job.status.value, product_name=name if isinstance(name, str) else "",
        external_product_id=snap.external_product_id, revision_count=job.revision_count, max_revisions=job.max_revisions,
        attempts=job.attempts, error_code=job.error_code, content_status=content.status.value,
        current_version_no=version.version_no if version else None,
        validation_passed=validation.passed if validation else None, quality_acceptable=quality.acceptable if quality else None,
        publication_status=latest[job.content_id].status.value if job.content_id in latest else None,
        created_at=job.created_at, updated_at=job.updated_at,
    )


@router.get("/workspaces/{workspace_id}/product-content/jobs", response_model=list[JobSummary])
async def list_jobs(workspace_id: uuid.UUID, _: Membership = Depends(require_workspace_member), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
    jobs = list((await session.execute(select(ProductContentJob).where(ProductContentJob.workspace_id == workspace_id)
                                       .order_by(ProductContentJob.created_at.desc()).limit(LIST_LIMIT))).scalars())
    snapshots, contents, versions, latest = await _context(session, workspace_id, jobs)
    return [_summary(j, snapshots, contents, versions, latest) for j in jobs]


@router.get("/workspaces/{workspace_id}/product-content/jobs/{job_id}", response_model=JobDetail)
async def job_detail(workspace_id: uuid.UUID, job_id: uuid.UUID, _: Membership = Depends(require_workspace_member), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session)):
    job = (await session.execute(select(ProductContentJob).where(
        ProductContentJob.id == job_id, ProductContentJob.workspace_id == workspace_id))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if job is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found in workspace")
    snapshots, contents, versions, latest = await _context(session, workspace_id, [job])
    summary = _summary(job, snapshots, contents, versions, latest)
    content, snap = contents[job.content_id], snapshots[job.snapshot_id]
    rows = list((await session.execute(select(ContentVersion).where(
        ContentVersion.workspace_id == workspace_id, ContentVersion.content_id == content.id).order_by(ContentVersion.version_no.asc()))).scalars())
    approvals = list((await session.execute(select(Approval).where(
        Approval.workspace_id == workspace_id, Approval.content_id == content.id).order_by(Approval.created_at.asc()))).scalars())
    publications = list((await session.execute(select(Publication).where(
        Publication.workspace_id == workspace_id, Publication.content_id == content.id).order_by(Publication.created_at.desc()))).scalars())
    now, data = datetime.now(UTC), snap.data if isinstance(snap.data, dict) else {}
    txt = lambda key: data[key] if isinstance(data.get(key), str) else ""  # noqa: E731
    opt = lambda key: data[key] if isinstance(data.get(key), str) else None  # noqa: E731
    return JobDetail(
        **summary.model_dump(), last_error=sanitize_error(job.last_error) if job.last_error else None,
        current_version_id=content.current_version_id,
        snapshot=SnapshotView(
            id=snap.id, external_product_id=snap.external_product_id, fetched_at=snap.fetched_at, source_hash=snap.source_hash[:12],
            name=txt("name"), sku=txt("sku"), price=opt("price"), regular_price=opt("regular_price"), sale_price=opt("sale_price"),
            stock_status=opt("stock_status"), categories=[c for c in data.get("categories", []) if isinstance(c, str)][:20],
        ),
        versions=[VersionView(
            id=v.id, version_no=v.version_no, source=v.source.value, model=v.model, prompt_version=v.prompt_version,
            content_hash=v.content_hash, created_at=v.created_at, is_current=v.id == content.current_version_id,
            revises_version_no=v.version_no - 1 if v.source.value != "ai_generation" and v.version_no > 1 else None,
            payload=_payload(v.payload), validation=_validation(v.validation_report), quality=_quality(v.quality_report),
        ) for v in rows],
        approvals=[ApprovalView(id=a.id, decision=a.decision, content_version_id=a.content_version_id, approver_user_id=a.approver_user_id,
                                reviewer_name=a.actor, note=a.note, created_at=a.created_at) for a in approvals],
        publications=[_publication(p, now) for p in publications],
    )

"""Phase 6 backend read contracts used by the Product Content UI."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import uuid

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import text

from app import product_generation as gen
from app.auth import create_access_token
from app.domain import Membership, User, WorkspaceRole
from app.product_views import router as views_router
from tests.conftest import make_world
from tests.test_product_generation import GOOD, FakeAI, make_job
from tests.test_wordpress_publication import FakeWP, api_client, approved, hdr, requested

db = pytest.mark.skipif(not os.getenv("DATABASE_URL"), reason="DATABASE_URL is required")


async def member_header(sf, w, role):
    async with sf() as s:
        user = User(email=f"m-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com", password_hash="x", full_name="M")
        s.add(user)
        await s.flush()
        s.add(Membership(workspace_id=w.workspace_id, user_id=user.id, role=role))
        await s.commit()
        return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {create_access_token(user)}"}


@db
async def test_list_and_detail_expose_the_whole_lifecycle_to_any_member(sf):
    w, other = await make_world(sf), await make_world(sf)
    job, version_id, pid = await requested(sf, w)
    base = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{w.workspace_id}/product-content/jobs"
    viewer = await member_header(sf, w, WorkspaceRole.viewer)
    async with api_client(sf, views_router) as c:
        listing = await c.get(base, headers=viewer)
        detail = await c.get(f"{base}/{job.id}", headers=viewer)
    (row,) = listing.json()
    assert row["job_id"] == str(job.id) and row["status"] == "ready_for_review" and row["product_name"] == "Ceramic Mug"
    assert row["content_status"] == "publish_requested" and row["publication_status"] == "pending"
    assert (row["current_version_no"], row["validation_passed"], row["quality_acceptable"]) == (1, True, True)
    assert (row["revision_count"], row["max_revisions"]) == (0, 2)
    d = detail.json()
    (v,) = d["versions"]

cat > lib/api.ts <<'EOF'
// Single API client for the Product Content UI. Same conventions as the existing pages:
// base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`, JWT/workspace kept under the
// same localStorage keys (`engage_token`, `engage_workspace_id`). The backend is the only authority.

export type ApiErrorKind = 'network' | 'auth' | 'forbidden' | 'not_found' | 'conflict' | 'validation' | 'unavailable' | 'server';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly kind: ApiErrorKind;
  readonly code?: string;
  constructor(kind: ApiErrorKind, status: number, message: string, code?: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
  }
  /** Network problems, 5xx and 503 can succeed on a later attempt. */
  get retryable(): boolean {
    return this.kind === 'network' || this.kind === 'server' || this.kind === 'unavailable';
  }
}

export const TOKEN_KEY = 'engage_token';
export const WORKSPACE_KEY = 'engage_workspace_id';
const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export function isUuid(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === 'string' && UUID_RE.test(value.trim());
}

/** IDs are interpolated into URL paths: only canonical UUIDs are accepted (no `..`, `/`, `?`). */
export function requireUuid(value: string, label: string): string {
  const v = (value ?? '').trim();
  if (!isUuid(v)) throw new ApiError('validation', 0, `${label} باید یک شناسه (UUID) معتبر باشد.`);
  return v.toLowerCase();
}

export function apiBase(): string {
  return (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:8000').replace(/\/+$/, '');
}

export function loadSession(): { token: string; workspaceId: string } {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return { token: '', workspaceId: '' };
  try {
    return { token: localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) ?? '', workspaceId: localStorage.getItem(WORKSPACE_KEY) ?? '' };
  } catch {
    return { token: '', workspaceId: '' };
  }
}

export function saveSession(token: string, workspaceId: string): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token.trim());
    localStorage.setItem(WORKSPACE_KEY, workspaceId.trim());
  } catch {
    /* storage unavailable: the session simply is not persisted */
  }
}

function describe(body: unknown, fallback: string): { message: string; code?: string } {
  const detail = body && typeof body === 'object' ? (body as { detail?: unknown }).detail : undefined;
  if (typeof detail === 'string') return { message: detail.slice(0, 300) };
  if (detail && typeof detail === 'object' && !Array.isArray(detail)) {
    const d = detail as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    return { message: typeof d.message === 'string' ? d.message.slice(0, 300) : fallback, code: typeof d.code === 'string' ? d.code : undefined };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
    const msgs = detail.map((x) => (x && typeof x === 'object' && typeof (x as { msg?: unknown }).msg === 'string' ? (x as { msg: string }).msg : '')).filter(Boolean);
    if (msgs.length) return { message: msgs.join('؛ ').slice(0, 300) };
  }
  return { message: fallback };
}

function kindFor(status: number): ApiErrorKind {
  if (status === 401) return 'auth';
  if (status === 403) return 'forbidden';
  if (status === 404) return 'not_found';
  if (status === 409 || status === 424) return 'conflict';
  if (status === 400 || status === 422) return 'validation';
  if (status === 503) return 'unavailable';
  return 'server';
}

export type RequestOptions = { token: string; method?: 'GET' | 'POST'; body?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal };

export async function apiRequest<T>(path: string, opts: RequestOptions): Promise<T> {
  if (!opts.token || !opts.token.trim()) throw new ApiError('auth', 401, 'ابتدا توکن دسترسی را وارد کنید.');
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${apiBase()}${path}`, {
      method: opts.method ?? 'GET',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${opts.token.trim()}` },
      body: opts.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(opts.body),
      signal: opts.signal,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError') throw error;
    throw new ApiError('network', 0, 'ارتباط با سرور برقرار نشد.');
  }
  let body: unknown = null;
  try {
    body = await response.json();
  } catch {
    body = null;
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const { message, code } = describe(body, `HTTP ${response.status}`);
    throw new ApiError(kindFor(response.status), response.status, message, code);
  }
  return body as T;
}
EOF
cat > lib/productContent.ts <<'EOF'
// Typed calls to the existing backend contracts. No business rules live here: the UI only sends what the user
// chose (a version id, a note, a credential id) - never an actor/reviewer identity or a workspace override.
import { apiRequest, requireUuid } from './api';
import type { CredentialView, JobDetail, JobSummary } from './types';

export type Session = { token: string; workspaceId: string };
const ws = (s: Session) => `/api/v1/workspaces/${requireUuid(s.workspaceId, 'شناسه Workspace')}`;

export const listJobs = (s: Session, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
  apiRequest<JobSummary[]>(`${ws(s)}/product-content/jobs`, { token: s.token, signal });

export const getJob = (s: Session, jobId: string, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
  apiRequest<JobDetail>(`${ws(s)}/product-content/jobs/${requireUuid(jobId, 'شناسه Job')}`, { token: s.token, signal });

export const createJob = (s: Session, credentialId: string, externalProductId: string) => {
  const id = (externalProductId ?? '').trim();
  return apiRequest<{ job_id: string; created: boolean }>(`${ws(s)}/product-content/jobs`, {
    token: s.token, method: 'POST',
    body: { credential_id: requireUuid(credentialId, 'شناسه Credential'), external_product_id: id },
  });
};

export const runJob = (s: Session, jobId: string) =>
  apiRequest<{ status: string }>(`${ws(s)}/product-content/jobs/${requireUuid(jobId, 'شناسه Job')}/run`, { token: s.token, method: 'POST' });

/** Review decision on the EXACT version shown to the reviewer. The reviewer identity is derived from the JWT server-side. */
export const reviewVersion = (s: Session, contentId: string, versionId: string, decision: 'approve' | 'reject', note: string) =>
  apiRequest<{ status: string }>(`${ws(s)}/contents/${requireUuid(contentId, 'شناسه محتوا')}/${decision}`, {
    token: s.token, method: 'POST', body: { content_version_id: requireUuid(versionId, 'شناسه نسخه'), note: note.slice(0, 5000) },
  });

export const requestPublication = (s: Session, contentId: string, credentialId: string, idempotencyKey: string) =>
  apiRequest<{ id: string; status: string }>(`${ws(s)}/contents/${requireUuid(contentId, 'شناسه محتوا')}/publish`, {
    token: s.token, method: 'POST', body: { idempotency_key: idempotencyKey, credential_id: requireUuid(credentialId, 'شناسه Credential') },
  });

export const executePublication = (s: Session, publicationId: string) =>
  apiRequest<{ status: string }>(`${ws(s)}/publications/${requireUuid(publicationId, 'شناسه انتشار')}/execute`, { token: s.token, method: 'POST' });

/** Optional helper: only owners/admins may list credentials; callers fall back to manual entry on 403. */
export const listCredentials = (s: Session) =>
  apiRequest<CredentialView[]>(`${ws(s)}/providers/credentials`, { token: s.token });

export function newIdempotencyKey(): string {
  const c = (globalThis as { crypto?: Crypto }).crypto;
  const random = c && 'randomUUID' in c ? c.randomUUID() : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  return `ui-${random}`;
}
EOF
cat > lib/status.ts <<'EOF'
import type { PublicationView } from './types';

export type Tone = 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad' | 'info' | 'neutral';
export type Label = { text: string; tone: Tone };

const JOB: Record<string, Label> = {
  queued: { text: 'در صف اجرا', tone: 'neutral' },
  generating: { text: 'در حال تولید', tone: 'info' },
  validating: { text: 'در حال اعتبارسنجی', tone: 'info' },
  quality_review: { text: 'بازبینی کیفیت', tone: 'info' },
  revising: { text: 'در حال بازنویسی', tone: 'info' },
  ready_for_review: { text: 'آماده‌ی بازبینی انسانی', tone: 'warn' },
  needs_attention: { text: 'نیازمند توجه', tone: 'bad' },
  completed: { text: 'تکمیل‌شده', tone: 'ok' },
  failed: { text: 'ناموفق', tone: 'bad' },
  cancelled: { text: 'لغوشده', tone: 'neutral' },
};
const CONTENT: Record<string, Label> = {
  draft: { text: 'پیش‌نویس', tone: 'neutral' },
  in_review: { text: 'در بازبینی', tone: 'warn' },
  approved: { text: 'تأییدشده', tone: 'ok' },
  rejected: { text: 'ردشده', tone: 'bad' },
  publish_requested: { text: 'درخواست انتشار ثبت شد', tone: 'info' },
  published: { text: 'منتشرشده', tone: 'ok' },
  failed: { text: 'انتشار ناموفق', tone: 'bad' },
};
const SOURCE: Record<string, string> = { ai_generation: 'تولید AI', ai_revision: 'بازنویسی AI', human_edit: 'ویرایش انسانی' };
const UNKNOWN = (raw: string): Label => ({ text: raw || '—', tone: 'neutral' });

export const jobLabel = (s: string): Label => JOB[s] ?? UNKNOWN(s);
export const contentLabel = (s: string): Label => CONTENT[s] ?? UNKNOWN(s);
export const sourceLabel = (s: string): string => SOURCE[s] ?? s;

/** One clear label for a publication; the flags come from the server (nothing is inferred client-side). */
export function publicationLabel(p: Pick<PublicationView, 'status' | 'in_progress' | 'retryable' | 'needs_attention'>): Label {
  if (p.status === 'published') return { text: 'منتشرشده', tone: 'ok' };
  if (p.needs_attention || p.status === 'failed') return { text: 'ناموفق — نیازمند توجه', tone: 'bad' };
  if (p.in_progress) return { text: 'در حال انجام', tone: 'info' };
  if (p.retryable) return { text: 'خطای موقت — قابل تلاش مجدد', tone: 'warn' };
  return { text: 'در انتظار اجرا', tone: 'neutral' };
}

export const publicationSummaryLabel = (status: string | null): Label =>
  status === null ? { text: 'بدون انتشار', tone: 'neutral' }
  : status === 'published' ? { text: 'منتشرشده', tone: 'ok' }
  : status === 'failed' ? { text: 'ناموفق', tone: 'bad' }
  : { text: 'در انتظار', tone: 'info' };

export const validationLabel = (passed: boolean | null): Label =>
  passed === null ? { text: 'اعتبارسنجی نشده', tone: 'neutral' } : passed ? { text: 'اعتبارسنجی موفق', tone: 'ok' } : { text: 'اعتبارسنجی ناموفق', tone: 'bad' };

export const qualityLabel = (acceptable: boolean | null): Label =>
  acceptable === null ? { text: 'کیفیت بررسی نشده', tone: 'neutral' } : acceptable ? { text: 'کیفیت قابل‌قبول', tone: 'ok' } : { text: 'کیفیت نامطلوب', tone: 'bad' };

export const decisionLabel = (d: string): Label =>
  d === 'approved' ? { text: 'تأیید', tone: 'ok' } : d === 'rejected' ? { text: 'رد', tone: 'bad' } : UNKNOWN(d);

/** Persian (Jalali) date/time; the exact ISO value stays available for tooltips. Invalid input is shown as-is. */
export function formatDateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return String(iso).slice(0, 40);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }).format(date);
}

export const shortId = (id: string | null | undefined): string => (id ? `${id.slice(0, 8)}…` : '—');

/** Prices are stored as plain decimal strings; show them with Persian digits and grouping. */
export function formatPrice(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '' || !/^\d{1,12}(\.\d{1,4})?$/.test(value)) return '—';
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR', { maximumFractionDigits: 4 }).format(Number(value));
}

export const formatNumber = (n: number): string => new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR').format(n);

/** Only absolute https URLs are ever turned into links (blocks javascript:, data:, http:, relative values). */
export function safeHttpsUrl(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value || value.length > 500) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

import { createElement, type ReactNode } from 'react';

// Generated content is UNTRUSTED. It is never injected as HTML: this tiny allowlist parser builds React elements
// (which escape all text). Only attribute-free formatting tags become elements; every other "tag" - scripts,
// images, anchors, anything with attributes, stray closers - is shown as literal text.
const ALLOWED = new Set(['p', 'h2', 'h3', 'ul', 'ol', 'li', 'strong', 'em', 'br']);
const MAX_INPUT = 100_000;
const ENTITIES: Record<string, string> = { '&amp;': '&', '&lt;': '<', '&gt;': '>', '&quot;': '"', '&#39;': "'", '&nbsp;': '\u00a0' };

export type SafeNode = { type: 'text'; text: string } | { type: 'el'; tag: string; children: SafeNode[] };

const decode = (text: string) => text.replace(/&(?:amp|lt|gt|quot|#39|nbsp);/g, (m) => ENTITIES[m] ?? m);

export function parseSafeHtml(input: string): SafeNode[] {
  const source = (input ?? '').slice(0, MAX_INPUT);
  const root: SafeNode[] = [];
  const stack: { tag: string; children: SafeNode[] }[] = [];
  const current = () => (stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1].children : root);
  const pushText = (text: string) => {
    if (text) current().push({ type: 'text', text: decode(text) });
  };
  const pattern = /<(\/?)([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)\s*(\/?)>|<[^<>]*>/g;
  let last = 0;
  for (let match = pattern.exec(source); match; match = pattern.exec(source)) {
    pushText(source.slice(last, match.index));
    last = match.index + match[0].length;
    const [raw, closing, nameRaw] = match;
    const tag = nameRaw?.toLowerCase();
    if (!tag || !ALLOWED.has(tag)) {
      current().push({ type: 'text', text: raw }); // not allowed (or has attributes): visible, inert text
    } else if (tag === 'br') {
      if (!closing) current().push({ type: 'el', tag: 'br', children: [] });
    } else if (!closing) {
      const node: SafeNode = { type: 'el', tag, children: [] };
      current().push(node);
      stack.push({ tag, children: node.children });
    } else if (stack.length && stack[stack.length - 1].tag === tag) {
      stack.pop();
    } else {
      current().push({ type: 'text', text: raw });
    }
  }
  pushText(source.slice(last));
  return root;
}

function render(nodes: SafeNode[], prefix: string): ReactNode[] {
  return nodes.map((node, i) => {
    const key = `${prefix}${i}`;
    if (node.type === 'text') return node.text;
    return createElement(node.tag, { key }, ...(node.tag === 'br' ? [] : render(node.children, `${key}.`)));
  });
}

/** Renders generated/external HTML as inert React elements. Direction follows the content (`dir="auto"`). */
export function SafeContent({ html }: { html: string }) {
  return (
    <div dir="auto" style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere', lineHeight: 1.95, unicodeBidi: 'plaintext' }} data-testid="safe-content">
      {render(parseSafeHtml(html), '')}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ApiError } from '../../lib/api';
import { safeHttpsUrl } from '../../lib/format';
import type { Label } from '../../lib/status';
import { button, buttonGhost, card, freeText, ltr, toneStyle } from '../../lib/ui';

export function Badge({ label }: { label: Label }) {
  return <span style={{ ...toneStyle[label.tone], borderRadius: 999, padding: '3px 10px', fontSize: 13, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{label.text}</span>;
}

/** Technical value (id, hash, model, timestamp ISO): always left-to-right, wrapped, optionally titled. */
export function Ltr({ children, title }: { children: ReactNode; title?: string }) {
  return <bdi dir="ltr" title={title} style={ltr}>{children}</bdi>;
}

/** Untrusted free text (names, notes, issue messages): React-escaped, direction follows the text. */
export function Text({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <span dir="auto" style={freeText}>{children}</span>;
}

export function Section({ title, children, aside }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; aside?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section style={{ ...card, marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 20 }}>{title}</h2>
        {aside}
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

export function Empty({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <p style={{ opacity: 0.6, margin: 0 }} role="status">{children}</p>;
}

export function Loading() {
  return <p role="status" aria-busy="true" style={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>در حال بارگذاری…</p>;
}

/** Link only for absolute https URLs; anything else is plain, inert text. */
export function SafeLink({ href }: { href: string | null | undefined }) {
  const safe = safeHttpsUrl(href);
  if (!safe) return <Ltr>{href ? String(href).slice(0, 200) : '—'}</Ltr>;
  return <a href={safe} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" dir="ltr" style={{ ...ltr, color: '#174A3A' }}>{safe}</a>;
}

const ERROR_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  network: 'ارتباط با سرور برقرار نشد. اتصال اینترنت یا آدرس API را بررسی کنید.',
  auth: 'نشست نامعتبر یا منقضی است. توکن دسترسی را دوباره وارد کنید.',
  forbidden: 'دسترسی ندارید: نقش شما در این Workspace اجازه‌ی این کار را نمی‌دهد.',
  not_found: 'مورد درخواستی در این Workspace پیدا نشد.',
  conflict: 'سرور این عملیات را در وضعیت فعلی نپذیرفت.',
  validation: 'ورودی نامعتبر است.',
  unavailable: 'سرویس موقتاً در دسترس نیست (مثلاً AI پیکربندی نشده است).',
  server: 'خطای سرور. کمی بعد دوباره تلاش کنید.',
};

export function ErrorNotice({ error, onRetry }: { error: unknown; onRetry?: () => void }) {
  const api = error instanceof ApiError ? error : null;
  const headline = api ? ERROR_TEXT[api.kind] : 'خطای ناشناخته رخ داد.';
  const serverMessage = api && api.kind !== 'network' && api.kind !== 'auth' && api.kind !== 'forbidden' && api.message ? api.message : '';
  return (
    <div role="alert" style={{ ...toneStyle.bad, borderRadius: 14, padding: '12px 14px', marginTop: 12 }}>
      <strong>{headline}</strong>
      {serverMessage && <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><Text>{serverMessage}</Text></div>}
      {api?.code && <div style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 13 }}>کد: <Ltr>{api.code}</Ltr></div>}
      {onRetry && api?.retryable && <button type="button" onClick={onRetry} style={{ ...buttonGhost, marginTop: 8 }}>تلاش مجدد</button>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Notice({ tone = 'info', children }: { tone?: 'ok' | 'info' | 'warn'; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <div role="status" style={{ ...toneStyle[tone], borderRadius: 14, padding: '10px 14px', marginTop: 12 }}>{children}</div>;
}

export { button, buttonGhost };

import { formatDateTime, formatNumber, shortId } from '../../lib/format';
import { qualityLabel, sourceLabel, validationLabel } from '../../lib/status';
import type { Issue, VersionView } from '../../lib/types';
import { card } from '../../lib/ui';
import { SafeContent } from '../../lib/safeHtml';
import { Badge, Empty, Ltr, Text } from './Common';

export function IssueList({ issues }: { issues: Issue[] }) {
  if (!issues.length) return null;
  return (
    <ul style={{ margin: '6px 0 0', paddingInlineStart: 20 }}>
      {issues.map((issue, i) => (
        <li key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
          <Ltr>{issue.code || issue.severity || 'issue'}</Ltr>
          {issue.field ? <> · <Ltr>{issue.field}</Ltr></> : null}
          {issue.message ? <> — <Text>{issue.message}</Text></> : null}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Read-only, immutable history: versions are only ever displayed, never edited. */
export function VersionHistory({ versions }: { versions: VersionView[] }) {
  if (!versions.length) return <Empty>هنوز نسخه‌ای تولید نشده است.</Empty>;
  return (
    <ol style={{ listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 12 }} aria-label="تاریخچه‌ی نسخه‌ها">
      {versions.map((v) => (
        <li key={v.id} style={{ ...card, padding: 14, borderColor: v.is_current ? '#174A3A' : undefined }} data-testid={`version-${v.version_no}`}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <strong>نسخه‌ی {formatNumber(v.version_no)}{v.is_current ? ' (جاری)' : ''}</strong>
            <span style={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>{sourceLabel(v.source)}{v.revises_version_no ? ` — بازنویسی نسخه‌ی ${formatNumber(v.revises_version_no)}` : ''}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Badge label={validationLabel(v.validation ? v.validation.passed : null)} />
            <Badge label={qualityLabel(v.quality ? v.quality.acceptable : null)} />
          </div>
          <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 0', fontSize: 13, opacity: 0.75 }}>
            ایجاد: <Ltr title={v.created_at}>{formatDateTime(v.created_at)}</Ltr>
            {v.model ? <> · مدل: <Ltr>{v.model}</Ltr></> : null}
            {v.prompt_version ? <> · prompt: <Ltr>{v.prompt_version}</Ltr></> : null}
            {' '}· hash: <Ltr title={v.content_hash}>{shortId(v.content_hash)}</Ltr>
          </p>
          {v.validation && !v.validation.passed && <div><strong>مشکلات اعتبارسنجی</strong><IssueList issues={v.validation.issues} /></div>}
          {v.quality && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              امتیاز کیفیت: {v.quality.score === null || v.quality.score === undefined ? '—' : formatNumber(v.quality.score)}
              {v.quality.provider ? <> · ارائه‌دهنده: <Ltr>{v.quality.provider}</Ltr></> : null}
              <IssueList issues={v.quality.issues} />
            </div>
          )}
          <details style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <summary style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>مشاهده‌ی محتوای این نسخه</summary>
            <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}><Text>{v.payload.title}</Text></h3>
            {v.payload.excerpt && <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px' }}><Text>{v.payload.excerpt}</Text></p>}
            <SafeContent html={v.payload.body} />
            {v.payload.meta_description && <p style={{ opacity: 0.7, fontSize: 14 }}>توضیح متا: <Text>{v.payload.meta_description}</Text></p>}
          </details>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { formatDateTime, formatNumber } from '../../lib/format';
import { decisionLabel } from '../../lib/status';
import type { ApprovalView, JobDetail } from '../../lib/types';
import { SafeContent } from '../../lib/safeHtml';
import { buttonDanger, input } from '../../lib/ui';
import { Badge, Empty, Ltr, Text, button } from './Common';
import { IssueList } from './VersionHistory';

/** UX gate only: the backend independently enforces state, version binding, roles and quality/validation rules. */
export function canOfferReview(d: Pick<JobDetail, 'status' | 'content_status' | 'current_version_id'>): boolean {
  return d.status === 'ready_for_review' && d.content_status === 'in_review' && d.current_version_id !== null;
}

export function ReviewPanel({ detail, busy, onDecision }: { detail: JobDetail; busy: boolean; onDecision: (decision: 'approve' | 'reject', versionId: string, note: string) => void }) {
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const version = detail.versions.find((v) => v.id === detail.current_version_id) ?? null;
  return (
    <div>
      {detail.approvals.length === 0 ? <Empty>هنوز تصمیم انسانی ثبت نشده است.</Empty> : (
        <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingInlineStart: 20 }} aria-label="تصمیم‌های بازبینی">
          {detail.approvals.map((a) => {
            const v = detail.versions.find((x) => x.id === a.content_version_id);
            return (
              <li key={a.id} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
                <Badge label={decisionLabel(a.decision)} /> نسخه‌ی {v ? formatNumber(v.version_no) : '—'} — بازبین: <Text>{a.reviewer_name || '—'}</Text>
                {' '}· <Ltr title={a.created_at}>{formatDateTime(a.created_at)}</Ltr>
                {a.note ? <div style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>یادداشت: <Text>{a.note}</Text></div> : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {canOfferReview(detail) && version && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 14, borderTop: '1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.08)', paddingTop: 12 }}>
          <strong>بازبینی نسخه‌ی {formatNumber(version.version_no)}</strong>
          <p style={{ margin: '6px 0', opacity: 0.75, fontSize: 14 }}>
            تصمیم شما روی همین نسخه (hash: <Ltr>{version.content_hash.slice(0, 12)}</Ltr>) و با هویت حساب کاربری شما ثبت می‌شود؛ اعتبار نهایی با سرور است.
          </p>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}><Text>{version.payload.title}</Text></h3>
          <SafeContent html={version.payload.body} />
          {version.validation && <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>اعتبارسنجی: {version.validation.passed ? 'موفق' : 'ناموفق'}<IssueList issues={version.validation.issues} /></div>}
          {version.quality && <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>کیفیت: {version.quality.acceptable ? 'قابل‌قبول' : 'نامطلوب'}<IssueList issues={version.quality.issues} /></div>}
          <label style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 12 }}>
            یادداشت (اختیاری)
            <textarea value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} maxLength={5000} dir="auto" style={{ ...input, minHeight: 80, marginTop: 6 }} />
          </label>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecision('approve', version.id, note)} style={button}>تأیید این نسخه</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecision('reject', version.id, note)} style={buttonDanger}>رد این نسخه</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';

}

                {(p.error_code || p.error_message) && (

                    {p.retryable ? 'آخرین خطا (تلاش مجدد انجام می‌شود)' : 'خطا'}: {p.error_code ? <Ltr>{p.error_code}</Ltr> : null}{p.error_message ? <> — <Text>{p.error_message}</Text></> : null}

          })}

      {canOfferPublish(detail) && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 14, borderTop: '1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.08)', paddingTop: 12 }}>

import { formatDateTime, formatNumber, formatPrice } from '../../lib/format';
import { contentLabel, jobLabel, qualityLabel, validationLabel } from '../../lib/status';
import type { CredentialView, JobDetail } from '../../lib/types';
import { Badge, Ltr, Notice, Section, Text, button } from './Common';
import { PublicationPanel } from './PublicationPanel';
import { ReviewPanel } from './ReviewPanel';
import { VersionHistory } from './VersionHistory';

export type DetailActions = {
  onRun: () => void;
  onDecision: (decision: 'approve' | 'reject', versionId: string, note: string) => void;
  onPublish: (credentialId: string) => void;
  onExecute: (publicationId: string) => void;
};

export function JobDetailView({ detail, credentials, busy, notice, actions }: {
  detail: JobDetail; credentials: CredentialView[] | null; busy: boolean; notice?: string | null; actions: DetailActions;
}) {
  const current = detail.versions.find((v) => v.is_current) ?? null;
  const s = detail.snapshot;
  return (
    <div dir="rtl">
      <header>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 'clamp(26px,4vw,40px)' }}><Text>{detail.product_name || `محصول ${detail.external_product_id}`}</Text></h1>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 10 }}>
          <Badge label={jobLabel(detail.status)} />
          <Badge label={contentLabel(detail.content_status)} />
          <Badge label={validationLabel(current?.validation ? current.validation.passed : null)} />
          <Badge label={qualityLabel(current?.quality ? current.quality.acceptable : null)} />
        </div>
        {notice && <Notice tone="ok">{notice}</Notice>}
      </header>

      <Section title="وضعیت چرخه‌ی تولید">
        <p style={{ margin: 0, lineHeight: 2 }}>
          بازنویسی: {formatNumber(detail.revision_count)} از حداکثر {formatNumber(detail.max_revisions)} · تلاش‌ها: {formatNumber(detail.attempts)} ·
          نسخه‌ی جاری: {detail.current_version_id && current ? formatNumber(current.version_no) : '—'}
        </p>
        {detail.error_code && <p style={{ margin: '6px 0 0' }}>خطا: <Ltr>{detail.error_code}</Ltr>{detail.last_error ? <> — <Text>{detail.last_error}</Text></> : null}</p>}
        {detail.status === 'needs_attention' && <Notice tone="warn">سقف بازنویسی خودکار پر شده یا اعتبارسنجی موفق نبوده است؛ نسخه‌ها را بررسی کنید.</Notice>}
        {detail.status === 'queued' && (
          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={actions.onRun} style={{ ...button, marginTop: 10 }}>اجرای تولید محتوا</button>
        )}
      </Section>

      <Section title="اطلاعات محصول (Snapshot)">
        <dl style={{ margin: 0, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'max-content 1fr', gap: '6px 16px' }}>
          <dt>شناسه در WooCommerce</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><Ltr>{s.external_product_id}</Ltr></dd>
          <dt>نام</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><Text>{s.name || '—'}</Text></dd>
          <dt>SKU</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><Ltr>{s.sku || '—'}</Ltr></dd>
          <dt>قیمت</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{formatPrice(s.price)}{s.sale_price ? ` (تخفیفی؛ قیمت اصلی ${formatPrice(s.regular_price)})` : ''}</dd>
          <dt>موجودی</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><Ltr>{s.stock_status ?? '—'}</Ltr></dd>
          <dt>دسته‌ها</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{s.categories.length ? s.categories.map((c, i) => <span key={i}>{i ? '، ' : ''}<Text>{c}</Text></span>) : '—'}</dd>
          <dt>زمان دریافت</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><Ltr title={s.fetched_at}>{formatDateTime(s.fetched_at)}</Ltr> · hash <Ltr>{s.source_hash}</Ltr></dd>
        </dl>
      </Section>

      <Section title="تاریخچه‌ی نسخه‌ها (تغییرناپذیر)"><VersionHistory versions={detail.versions} /></Section>
      <Section title="بازبینی انسانی"><ReviewPanel detail={detail} busy={busy} onDecision={actions.onDecision} /></Section>
      <Section title="انتشار در WordPress">
        <PublicationPanel detail={detail} credentials={credentials} busy={busy} onPublish={actions.onPublish} onExecute={actions.onExecute} />
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ApiError, loadSession, saveSession } from '../../lib/api';
import { createJob, listJobs } from '../../lib/productContent';
import type { JobSummary } from '../../lib/types';
import { button, card, input, page } from '../../lib/ui';
import { ErrorNotice, Loading, Notice } from '../../components/product/Common';
import { JobList } from '../../components/product/JobList';

type State = { phase: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'; jobs: JobSummary[]; error: unknown };

export default function ProductContentPage() {
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [workspaceId, setWorkspaceId] = useState('');
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>({ phase: 'idle', jobs: [], error: null });
  const [credentialId, setCredentialId] = useState('');
  const [productId, setProductId] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<unknown>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async (session: { token: string; workspaceId: string }) => {
    setState((s) => ({ ...s, phase: 'loading', error: null }));
    try {
      saveSession(session.token, session.workspaceId);
      setState({ phase: 'ready', jobs: await listJobs(session), error: null });
    } catch (error) {
      setState({ phase: 'error', jobs: [], error });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const session = loadSession();
    setToken(session.token);
    setWorkspaceId(session.workspaceId);
    if (session.token && session.workspaceId) void load(session);
  }, [load]);

  async function create() {
    setBusy(true);
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      const result = await createJob({ token, workspaceId }, credentialId, productId);
      window.location.href = `/product-content/${result.job_id}`;
    } catch (error) {
      setFormError(error);
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main dir="rtl" style={page}>
      <section style={{ maxWidth: 1000, margin: '0 auto' }}>
        <a href="/" style={{ color: '#174A3A', textDecoration: 'none' }}>← Risheh Engage</a>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 'clamp(30px,5vw,52px)', margin: '8px 0' }}>محتوای محصول</h1>
        <p style={{ opacity: 0.7, lineHeight: 1.9 }}>WooCommerce ← تولید و اعتبارسنجی ← بازبینی انسانی ← انتشار در WordPress. تمام قواعد را سرور اعمال می‌کند.</p>

        <div style={{ ...card, display: 'grid', gap: 12, gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr))', alignItems: 'end' }}>
          <label>JWT Access Token<textarea value={token} onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)} dir="ltr" style={{ ...input, minHeight: 70 }} /></label>
          <label>Workspace ID<input value={workspaceId} onChange={(e) => setWorkspaceId(e.target.value)} dir="ltr" style={input} /></label>
          <button type="button" style={button} disabled={!token || !workspaceId || state.phase === 'loading'} onClick={() => void load({ token, workspaceId })}>بارگذاری Jobها</button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ ...card, marginTop: 16 }}>
          <strong>ساخت Job از WooCommerce</strong>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12, gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr))', marginTop: 10 }}>
            <label>شناسه‌ی Credential ووکامرس<input value={credentialId} onChange={(e) => setCredentialId(e.target.value)} dir="ltr" style={input} /></label>
            <label>شناسه‌ی محصول<input value={productId} onChange={(e) => setProductId(e.target.value)} dir="ltr" inputMode="numeric" style={input} /></label>
          </div>
          <button type="button" style={{ ...button, marginTop: 12 }} disabled={busy || !token || !workspaceId || !credentialId || !productId} onClick={() => void create()}>دریافت محصول و ساخت Job</button>
          {Boolean(formError) && <ErrorNotice error={formError} />}
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
          {state.phase === 'idle' && <Notice>توکن و Workspace را وارد کنید.</Notice>}
          {state.phase === 'loading' && <Loading />}
          {state.phase === 'error' && <ErrorNotice error={state.error} onRetry={() => void load({ token, workspaceId })} />}
          {state.phase === 'ready' && <JobList jobs={state.jobs} hrefFor={(job) => `/product-content/${job.job_id}`} />}
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

export { ApiError };

'use client';

import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { loadSession } from '../../../lib/api';
import { executePublication, getJob, listCredentials, newIdempotencyKey, requestPublication, reviewVersion, runJob } from '../../../lib/productContent';
import type { CredentialView, JobDetail } from '../../../lib/types';
import { page } from '../../../lib/ui';
import { ErrorNotice, Loading, Notice } from '../../../components/product/Common';
import { JobDetailView } from '../../../components/product/JobDetailView';

export default function ProductContentJobPage() {
  const { jobId } = useParams<{ jobId: string }>();
  const [session, setSession] = useState({ token: '', workspaceId: '' });
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<JobDetail | null>(null);
  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState<CredentialView[] | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const publishKey = useRef<string | null>(null); // one key per publish intent: a retried click reuses it (idempotent)

  const refresh = useCallback(async (s: { token: string; workspaceId: string }) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setDetail(await getJob(s, jobId));
    } catch (e) {
      setDetail(null);
      setError(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [jobId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const s = loadSession();
    setSession(s);
    if (s.token && s.workspaceId) {
      void refresh(s);
      listCredentials(s).then(setCredentials).catch(() => setCredentials(null)); // owners/admins only; otherwise manual entry
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [refresh]);

  async function act(message: string, call: () => Promise<unknown>, done?: () => void) {
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      await call();
      done?.();
      setNotice(message);
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(e); // the server decides; its refusal is shown as-is
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      await refresh(session);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main dir="rtl" style={page}>
      <section style={{ maxWidth: 1000, margin: '0 auto' }}>
        <a href="/product-content" style={{ color: '#174A3A', textDecoration: 'none' }}>← فهرست Jobها</a>
        {!session.token || !session.workspaceId ? <Notice tone="warn">ابتدا از صفحه‌ی فهرست، توکن و Workspace را وارد کنید.</Notice> : null}
        {loading && <Loading />}
        {Boolean(error) && <ErrorNotice error={error} onRetry={() => void refresh(session)} />}
        {Boolean(actionError) && <ErrorNotice error={actionError} />}
        {detail && !error && (
          <JobDetailView
            detail={detail}
            credentials={credentials}
            busy={busy}
            notice={notice}
            actions={{
              onRun: () => void act('اجرای تولید محتوا انجام شد.', () => runJob(session, detail.job_id)),
              onDecision: (decision, versionId, note) =>
                void act(decision === 'approve' ? 'نسخه تأیید شد.' : 'نسخه رد شد.', () => reviewVersion(session, detail.content_id, versionId, decision, note)),
              onPublish: (credentialId) => {
                publishKey.current = publishKey.current ?? newIdempotencyKey();
                void act('درخواست انتشار ثبت شد.', () => requestPublication(session, detail.content_id, credentialId, publishKey.current as string), () => { publishKey.current = null; });
              },
              onExecute: (publicationId) => void act('اجرای انتشار انجام شد.', () => executePublication(session, publicationId)),
            }}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { afterEach, describe, it } from 'node:test';
import { ApiError, apiRequest, isUuid, requireUuid } from '../lib/api';
import { formatDateTime, formatNumber, formatPrice, safeHttpsUrl } from '../lib/format';
import { createJob, executePublication, getJob, listJobs, requestPublication, reviewVersion, runJob } from '../lib/productContent';
import { contentLabel, jobLabel, publicationLabel, publicationSummaryLabel, qualityLabel, sourceLabel, validationLabel } from '../lib/status';

type Call = { url: string; init: RequestInit };
const realFetch = globalThis.fetch;
function mockFetch(respond: (call: Call) => Response | Promise<Response>) {
  const calls: Call[] = [];
  globalThis.fetch = (async (url: string, init: RequestInit) => {
    const call = { url: String(url), init };
    calls.push(call);
    return respond(call);
  }) as typeof fetch;
  return calls;
}
const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
const session = { token: 'jwt-token', workspaceId: WS };
afterEach(() => { globalThis.fetch = realFetch; });

describe('api client', () => {
  it('sends the bearer token and never calls the network without one', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch(() => json([]));
    await listJobs(session);
    assert.equal(calls[0].url, `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/workspaces/${WS}/product-content/jobs`);
    assert.equal((calls[0].init.headers as Record<string, string>).Authorization, 'Bearer jwt-token');
    await assert.rejects(listJobs({ token: '  ', workspaceId: WS }), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'auth');
    assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  });

  it('maps HTTP failures to typed, user-meaningful errors', async () => {
    const table: [number, unknown, string, boolean][] = [
      [401, { detail: 'Invalid token' }, 'auth', false], [403, { detail: 'Workspace access denied' }, 'forbidden', false],
      [404, { detail: 'nope' }, 'not_found', false], [409, { detail: 'Invalid transition' }, 'conflict', false],
      [424, { detail: { code: 'invalid_credentials', message: 'rejected' } }, 'conflict', false],
      [422, { detail: [{ msg: 'field required' }, { msg: 'bad uuid' }] }, 'validation', false],
      [503, { detail: 'AI provider is not configured' }, 'unavailable', true], [500, {}, 'server', true],
    ];
    for (const [status, body, kind, retryable] of table) {
      mockFetch(() => json(body, status));
      await assert.rejects(getJob(session, JOB), (e: ApiError) => {
        assert.equal(e.kind, kind, String(status));
        assert.equal(e.retryable, retryable);
        assert.equal(e.status, status);
        return true;
      });
    }
    mockFetch(() => json({ detail: { code: 'invalid_credentials', message: 'rejected' } }, 424));
    await assert.rejects(getJob(session, JOB), (e: ApiError) => e.code === 'invalid_credentials' && e.message === 'rejected');
    mockFetch(() => new Response('<html>proxy error</html>', { status: 502 }));
    await assert.rejects(getJob(session, JOB), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'server' && e.message === 'HTTP 502');
  });

  it('reports network failures as retryable', async () => {
    globalThis.fetch = (async () => { throw new TypeError('fetch failed'); }) as typeof fetch;
    await assert.rejects(getJob(session, JOB), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'network' && e.retryable);
  });

  it('long server messages are truncated', async () => {
    mockFetch(() => json({ detail: 'x'.repeat(5000) }, 409));
    await assert.rejects(getJob(session, JOB), (e: ApiError) => e.message.length <= 300);
  });
});

describe('workspace / path boundary', () => {
  it('only canonical UUIDs reach a URL path', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch(() => json({}));
    for (const bad of ['', '../../etc/passwd', `${WS}/../x`, `${WS}?a=1`, 'not-a-uuid', `${WS}\n`.replace('\n', '%0a')]) {
      assert.equal(isUuid(bad), false);
      await assert.rejects(listJobs({ token: 't', workspaceId: bad }), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'validation');
      await assert.rejects(getJob(session, bad), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'validation');
    }
    assert.equal(calls.length, 0);
    assert.equal(requireUuid(` ${WS.toUpperCase()} `, 'x'), WS);
  });

  it('the workspace is always the one in the session (never taken from a response or a body)', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch(() => json({ workspace_id: '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999', job_id: JOB, created: true }));
    await createJob(session, CRED, '42');
    await runJob(session, JOB);
    await executePublication(session, JOB);
    assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.url.includes(`/workspaces/${WS}/`)));
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(calls[0].init.body)), { credential_id: CRED, external_product_id: '42' });
  });
});

describe('approval flow contract', () => {
  it('approves/rejects an exact version and never sends a reviewer identity', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch(() => json({ status: 'approved' }));
    await reviewVersion(session, CONTENT, V1, 'approve', 'عالی');
    await reviewVersion(session, CONTENT, V1, 'reject', 'x'.repeat(9000));
    assert.equal(calls[0].url, `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/workspaces/${WS}/contents/${CONTENT}/approve`);
    assert.equal(calls[1].url.endsWith('/reject'), true);
    const body = JSON.parse(String(calls[0].init.body));
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(body).sort(), ['content_version_id', 'note']);
    assert.equal(body.content_version_id, V1);
    for (const forbidden of ['actor', 'approver', 'approver_user_id', 'reviewer', 'reviewer_name', 'user_id', 'status', 'workspace_id']) assert.ok(!(forbidden in body));
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(String(calls[1].init.body)).note.length, 5000);
    await assert.rejects(reviewVersion(session, CONTENT, 'nope', 'approve', ''), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'validation');
  });

  it('publication requests carry only an idempotency key and a credential - no state', async () => {
    const calls = mockFetch(() => json({ id: JOB, status: 'pending' }));
    await requestPublication(session, CONTENT, CRED, 'ui-key-123456');
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(calls[0].init.body)), { idempotency_key: 'ui-key-123456', credential_id: CRED });
    await assert.rejects(requestPublication(session, CONTENT, 'x', 'ui-key-123456'), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'validation');
  });

  it('server refusals surface unchanged (the UI does not second-guess authorization)', async () => {
    mockFetch(() => json({ detail: 'The current version has not been approved' }, 409));
    await assert.rejects(requestPublication(session, CONTENT, CRED, 'ui-key-123456'), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'conflict' && /not been approved/.test(e.message));
    mockFetch(() => json({ detail: 'Insufficient workspace role' }, 403));
    await assert.rejects(reviewVersion(session, CONTENT, V1, 'approve', ''), (e: ApiError) => e.kind === 'forbidden');
  });
});

describe('status mapping', () => {
  it('maps every backend state to a Persian label and a tone', () => {
    for (const s of ['queued', 'generating', 'validating', 'quality_review', 'revising', 'ready_for_review', 'needs_attention', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled']) {
      assert.match(jobLabel(s).text, /[\u0600-\u06FF]/, s);
    }
    for (const s of ['draft', 'in_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'publish_requested', 'published', 'failed']) assert.match(contentLabel(s).text, /[\u0600-\u06FF]/, s);
    assert.deepEqual(jobLabel('weird_new_state'), { text: 'weird_new_state', tone: 'neutral' });
    assert.equal(jobLabel('needs_attention').tone, 'bad');
    assert.equal(sourceLabel('ai_revision'), 'بازنویسی AI');
    assert.equal(validationLabel(null).tone, 'neutral');
    assert.equal(validationLabel(false).tone, 'bad');
    assert.equal(qualityLabel(true).tone, 'ok');
    assert.equal(publicationSummaryLabel(null).text, 'بدون انتشار');
  });

  it('publication states come from server flags: pending / in progress / retryable / failed / published', () => {
    const base = { status: 'pending', in_progress: false, retryable: false, needs_attention: false };
    assert.equal(publicationLabel(base).text, 'در انتظار اجرا');
    assert.equal(publicationLabel({ ...base, in_progress: true }).text, 'در حال انجام');
    assert.equal(publicationLabel({ ...base, retryable: true }).tone, 'warn');
    assert.equal(publicationLabel({ ...base, status: 'failed', needs_attention: true }).tone, 'bad');
    assert.equal(publicationLabel({ ...base, status: 'published' }).tone, 'ok');
  });
});

describe('formatting (Persian / technical values)', () => {
  it('uses Persian digits and Jalali dates; invalid input is shown verbatim', () => {
    assert.match(formatNumber(12), /^[۰-۹]+$/);
    assert.match(formatPrice('199000'), /^[۰-۹٬]+$/);
    assert.equal(formatPrice('abc'), '—');
    assert.match(formatDateTime('2026-03-01T10:00:00Z'), /[۰-۹]/);
    assert.equal(formatDateTime('garbage'), 'garbage');
    assert.equal(formatDateTime(null), '—');
  });
  it('turns only absolute https URLs into links', () => {
    assert.equal(safeHttpsUrl('https://blog.example.com/p/1'), 'https://blog.example.com/p/1');
    for (const bad of ['javascript:alert(1)', 'data:text/html,x', 'http://blog.example.com', '//evil.example.com', '/relative', 'https://user:pw@evil.example.com/', 'ftp://x.example.com', '', null, undefined]) {
      assert.equal(safeHttpsUrl(bad as string), null, String(bad));
    }
  });
});

describe('base request', () => {
  it('passes an abort signal through and rethrows aborts untouched', async () => {
    globalThis.fetch = (async () => { throw new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError'); }) as typeof fetch;
    await assert.rejects(apiRequest('/x', { token: 't', signal: new AbortController().signal }), (e: Error) => e.name === 'AbortError');
  });
});

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
import { ApiError } from '../lib/api';
import { parseSafeHtml, SafeContent } from '../lib/safeHtml';

import { JobDetailView } from '../components/product/JobDetailView';
import { JobList } from '../components/product/JobList';

import { CONTENT, CRED, detail, publication, summary, V1, V2, version } from './fixtures';

const html = (node: React.ReactElement) => renderToStaticMarkup(node);
const noop = () => undefined;
const actions = { onRun: noop, onDecision: noop, onPublish: noop, onExecute: noop };
const view = (d = detail(), creds: Parameters<typeof JobDetailView>[0]['credentials'] = null) =>
  html(<JobDetailView detail={d} credentials={creds} busy={false} actions={actions} />);

const ATTACKS = [
  '<script>alert(1)</script>', '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>', '<p onclick="alert(1)">x</p>', '<a href="javascript:alert(1)">click</a>',
  '<iframe src="https://evil.example.com"></iframe>', '<svg onload=alert(1)>', '<style>*{display:none}</style>', '<b onmouseover=1>b</b>',
  '"><script>alert(1)</script>', '<p>ok</p></div><script>x</script>',
];

describe('unsafe content is rendered inert', () => {
  it('SafeContent never emits active elements or attributes', () => {
    for (const attack of ATTACKS) {

      assert.doesNotMatch(out, /<(script|img|iframe|svg|style|a|b)[\s>]/i, attack);
      assert.doesNotMatch(out, /\son\w+=/i, attack);
      assert.doesNotMatch(out, /href=/i, attack);
    }
    assert.match(html(<SafeContent html="<script>alert(1)</script>" />), /&lt;script&gt;alert\(1\)&lt;\/script&gt;/);
  });

  it('keeps allowlisted formatting and decodes entities exactly once', () => {
    const out = html(<SafeContent html="<h2>عنوان</h2><p>الف <strong>ب</strong><br>ج &amp;lt; &lt;b&gt;</p><ul><li>یک</li></ul>" />);
    assert.match(out, /<h2>عنوان<\/h2><p>الف <strong>ب<\/strong><br\/>ج &amp;lt; &lt;b&gt;<\/p><ul><li>یک<\/li><\/ul>/);
    assert.deepEqual(parseSafeHtml('<p>a</p></li>').map((n) => n.type), ['el', 'text']);
    assert.equal(html(<SafeContent html={'x'.repeat(300_000)} />).length < 120_000, true);
  });

  it('attacker-controlled names, notes, errors and issues are escaped everywhere', () => {

      product_name: evil, last_error: evil, error_code: 'x', snapshot: { ...detail().snapshot, name: evil, categories: [evil] },
      versions: [version({ payload: { title: evil, excerpt: evil, body: evil, meta_description: evil },
        validation: { passed: false, validator_version: 'v', issues: [{ code: 'c', field: 'f', message: evil }] }, quality: null })],
      approvals: [{ id: 'a', decision: 'approved', content_version_id: V1, approver_user_id: null, reviewer_name: evil, note: evil, created_at: '2026-03-01T10:00:00Z' }],
      publications: [publication({ error_code: 'c', error_message: evil, status: 'published', external_id: '9', external_url: 'javascript:alert(1)' })],
    });
    const out = view(d) + html(<JobList jobs={[summary({ product_name: evil })]} hrefFor={() => '/x'} />);

    assert.match(out, /&lt;img src=x onerror=alert\(1\)&gt;/);

describe('Persian / RTL rendering', () => {
  it('the detail view is RTL, Persian, with technical values isolated left-to-right', () => {

  it('list items show the Persian status vocabulary', () => {

});

describe('job list & detail states', () => {

  it('shows lifecycle, revision budget, snapshot and errors', () => {

describe('version history (immutable, read-only)', () => {
  const versions = [
    version({ id: V1, version_no: 1, is_current: false, validation: { passed: false, validator_version: 'v', issues: [{ code: 'disallowed_tag', field: 'body', message: '<script> is not allowed' }] }, quality: null }),

describe('human review panel', () => {
  const ready = detail();
  it('is offered for the exact current version when the server state is reviewable', () => {
    assert.equal(canOfferReview(ready), true);

    assert.match(panel(detail()), /هنوز درخواست انتشاری/);
  });
